black seraphs glare.name: Black Seraphs Glare
black seraphs glare.text: Disciples of the Black Seraph know that half the battle is won through the mind, and by attacking his opponents mind with fear, he can goad him to make mistakes and shatter his resolve and confidence.

gutstrike.name: Gutstrike
gutstrike.text: With a ruthless attack or a powerful kick, the disciple strikes a foe in a way that causes him to become sickened with pain.

ravaging blow.name: Ravaging Blow
ravaging blow.text: Fear is one of the main weapons in the arsenal of a Black Seraph disciple, and by using it he may shake his opponent to their core.

savage stance.name: Savage Stance
savage stance.text: The blood is the life and the disciple of the Black Seraph knows that by spilling it in great amounts, he does glory to the lower planes.

strength of hell.name: Strength of Hell
strength of hell.text: By utilizing his bond to the lower planes from his training, the darkness he welcomed as his own, the martial disciple is capable of increasing his power at the cost of defense by bringing forth a momentary burst of hysterical fiendish stre

voracious drive.name: Voracious Drive
voracious drive.text: The relentless nature of the Black Seraph disciplines philosophy deems that progression must be made with each swing, lest the battle turn against the disciple.

fear eating technique.name: Fear Eating Technique
fear eating technique.text: The disciples soul hungers for the fear it inspires on the battlefield, and rewards can be gained by inspiring it with greater vigor.

inner demon strike.name: Inner Demon Strike
inner demon strike.text: By using the black energies within him as a weapon, the disciple may channel it through his mortal form to do devastating damage to his foes, all the while heedless of the damage inflicted upon his body.

intimidating force.name: Intimidating Force
intimidating force.text: By using this technique, the disciples fear-inspiring countenance alone may turn aside attacks before they occur.

seraphs wrath.name: Seraphs Wrath
seraphs wrath.text: The Black Seraph disciple uses the principles of overwhelming force to drive his opponent back so that he may continue to wade forward towards conquest.

shadow feather strike.name: Shadow Feather Strike
shadow feather strike.text: By concentrating dark, spiritual energy within his hand shaping it into a rough feather-like shape, the disciple may hurl his wrath at a target with a blade of a cutting hate.

black seraph battle stance.name: Black Seraph Battle Stance
black seraph battle stance.text: The Black Seraph discipline teaches its disciples that relentless aggression is what wins battles, and by channeling the very might of the lower planes themselves through his form, does he gain the advantage he yearns for.

savage drive.name: Savage Drive
savage drive.text: Ever hungry for carnage, the demonic disciple demands action and satisfaction through battle.

taunting laugh.name: Taunting Laugh
taunting laugh.text: With an intimidating growl and mighty laugh at his pitiful opponents, the Black Seraph disciple causes his foes resolve to weaken and his anger to stoke, allowing him to make the tragic mistake of giving the disciple the upper hand.

tendon rip.name: Tendon Rip
tendon rip.text: By striking at the legs of the opponent, the disciple removes the mobility of a foe, so the foe cannot hamper his progression to victory.

unfettered progression.name: Unfettered Progression
unfettered progression.text: By unceasing movement in combat, the Black Seraph disciple moves into a more beneficial position to deliver a deadly blow.

bilious strike.name: Bilious Strike
bilious strike.text: With a powerful strike to the abdomen, the Black Seraph disciple fills his opponent with destructive unholy power.

circle of razor feathers.name: Circle of Razor Feathers
circle of razor feathers.text: When surrounded, a disciple of the Black Seraph may lay low many foes by the force of his hellish wrath.

vengeful riposte.name: Vengeful Riposte
vengeful riposte.text: Disciples of the Black Seraph have trained themselves to look for openings while enemies attack, then respond with agonizing retorts, as vengeance is a creed the Black Seraph embraces.

walk in the dark.name: Walk in the Dark
walk in the dark.text: Using the principles of shadow and temporarily merging with the dark, the Black Seraph disciple becomes engulfed in smothering darkness and fear.

abyssal lance.name: Abyssal Lance
abyssal lance.text: Those who have become masters of the Black Seraph discipline have learned that by focusing the rage within themselves, they may use it as a weapon of pure destruction at the cost of their self.

sensory rip.name: Sensory Rip
sensory rip.text: With a high swing towards the face of his opponent, the Black Seraph disciple attempts to shatter the confidence and appearance of his enemy and remove from them the ability to see in the cruelest fashion with painful, scarring wounds.

sharing the dark soul.name: Sharing the Dark Soul
sharing the dark soul.text: By channeling their own internal despair and anguish, the disciple shares this inner pain with his enemies.

soul consumption.name: Soul Consumption
soul consumption.text: The fiendish energy channeled by the disciple hungers for the souls of fallen foes and it rewards the disciple with its unquenchable thirst.

abyssal drive.name: Abyssal Drive
abyssal drive.text: The path of the conqueror demands satisfaction, and the disciple of the Black Seraph learns perfection in conquest by the ever progressing tide of battle.

black seraphs wrath.name: Black Seraphs Wrath
black seraphs wrath.text: The disciple of the Black Seraphs anger and wrath are his strongest weapons, and in concentrating this hatred into his attacks, he may cause a horrible black power to invade the wounds of his foes to cause even more injury.

razor wings of the black seraph.name: Razor Wings of the Black Seraph
razor wings of the black seraph.text: The graceful hunting techniques of fallenangelslend their strength to the hellish Black Seraph disciple by his adoption of this stance.

shadow raptor swarm.name: Shadow Raptor Swarm
shadow raptor swarm.text: The power of a Black Seraph disciples hatred is made manifest by summoning a swarming mass of beating wings with razor tipped wings made of shadow that he directs at his foes in a cone of terror and rage.

armageddon lance.name: Armageddon Lance
armageddon lance.text: One the supreme arts of the Black Seraph discipline allows the disciple to call upon the fell and eternal wrath of his dark agreement with the lower planes and use it as a devastating lance of destructive unholy terror.

charge of the ravager.name: Charge of the Ravager
charge of the ravager.text: The path to victory is not a curved line, it is a straight, bloody line.

consumption strike.name: Consumption Strike
consumption strike.text: By channeling dark energies from the lower planes, the disciple of the Black Seraph may utilize this vampiric power through his attack, restoring health and strength to him at the cost of his foes vitality.

devastating riposte.name: Devastating Riposte
devastating riposte.text: The battle-hardened nature of the disciple of the Black Seraph can be shown in their ability to take a hit and give it back to their attacker three-fold.

apocalyptic strike.name: Apocalyptic Strike
apocalyptic strike.text: This master level technique of the Black Seraph discipline allows its disciples to bring forth the true power of destruction from the darkness within.

soul crusher.name: Soul Crusher
soul crusher.text: With a mighty swing or the barest tap, the rage and hatred within the Black Seraph infects his foe and destroys his resolve and very will to live.

vampiric aura.name: Vampiric Aura
vampiric aura.text: By opening ones self to the eternal hunger of the darkness that resides with the disciple, he may use himself as a filter for the life energies that feed this dark urge.

void seraph strike.name: Void Seraph Strike
void seraph strike.text: The Black Seraph disciples power and mastery is nearly complete, and with this maneuver he may dismiss his hatred and set it upon a foe to devour the fool who would stand before him.

black seraph onslaught.name: Black Seraph Onslaught
black seraph onslaught.text: A true master of the Black Seraph fears no foe, and suffers none to stand before him.

brawlers attitude.name: Brawlers Attitude
brawlers attitude.text: By using the skill of the empty-handed warriors that came before him, the disciple focuses his will to using his body in less conventional ways in combat.

flurry strike.name: Flurry Strike
flurry strike.text: The disciple of the Broken Blade learns to maximize openings in his opponents defenses and makes lightning fast attacks whenever possible.

iron hand stance.name: Iron Hand Stance
iron hand stance.text: By keeping his hands stiff and his arms loose and ready, the disciple uses his bare palms as shields to protect himself from the weapons of his foes.

pommel bash.name: Pommel Bash
pommel bash.text: When watching a Broken Bladefighterwork his art, most watch for the fists and feet.

pugilist stance.name: Pugilist Stance
pugilist stance.text: By adopting a powerful kickboxing stance, the initiator positions himself for lightning fast, potent strikes with his hands and feet.

shards of iron strike.name: Shards of Iron Strike
shards of iron strike.text: By mimicking the speed and piercing power of the legendary shattered blade of the founder of this discipline, the disciple makes a hard jabbing strike at his opponents vulnerable spots for maximum pain.

bronze knuckle.name: Bronze Knuckle
bronze knuckle.text: With a spectacular crack of his knuckles, the disciple delivers an extra-potent blow to his foe in the form of a bone-crushing strike.

cartwheel axe kick.name: Cartwheel Axe Kick
cartwheel axe kick.text: With a quick handspring into a cartwheel or flip, the disciple of the Broken Blade levels a powerful axe kick at his foe.

counter step.name: Counter Step
counter step.text: With a twist of his body or a nimble hop, the disciple of the Broken Blade avoids a blow with a practiced step.

knuckle to the blade.name: Knuckle to the Blade
knuckle to the blade.text: By striking at the weapon-wielding arm of his opponent, the disciple of the Broken Blade can cleverlydisarmhis opponent and potentially even bring his foes weapon to bear against him.

leg sweeping hilt.name: Leg Sweeping Hilt
leg sweeping hilt.text: With quick feint high, the disciple hooks his foot behind the leg of his foe and stiffens it like the hilt of a sword, drawing it back to knock his opponent down.

broken blade stance.name: Broken Blade Stance
broken blade stance.text: The disciple of the Broken Blade has learned the flows of combat to a degree and has the insight necessary to see the path to victory through the patterns of steel his opponents weave before his eyes.

flat iron riposte.name: Flat Iron Riposte
flat iron riposte.text: When an opponent swings to strike at the disciple, his finely trained body explodes into motion in a shower of incredible reflexes, grabbing the attackers attacking appendage andhurlinghim away.

iron dust.name: Iron Dust
iron dust.text: Knowing the disadvantage of fighting without proper steel in hand, the disciple of the Broken Blade must take advantage of his surroundings and openings in his foes defenses as he sees them.

steel flurry strike.name: Steel Flurry Strike
steel flurry strike.text: The disciple makes a furious set of attacks upon his foe, hammering through defenses and striking rapidly.

broken blade riposte.name: Broken Blade Riposte
broken blade riposte.text: Sometimes to give, one has to take. This ebb and flow that the disciple has mastered allows him to focus his pain into a forceful counter blow to drive his opponent back.

iron-breaking palm.name: Iron-Breaking Palm
iron-breaking palm.text: By targeting the very iron, wood, and steel he has eschewed for the simple use of his own limbs as weapons, he reduces his foes effectiveness by shattering theirillusionof superiority in combat.

iron axe kick.name: Iron Axe Kick
iron axe kick.text: The disciple leaps up into the air and raises his leg up tohammerit down in a bone-shattering axe kick.

iron knuckle.name: Iron Knuckle
iron knuckle.text: By tapping into hidden reserves of martial power locked within his form, the disciple of the Broken Blade makes his attacks strike with the force of a thousand fists.

iron mongers throw.name: Iron Mongers Throw
iron mongers throw.text: Opponents with their deadly blades and powerful spears can harry the disciple who fights with his hands, and the truth that is forgotten by filling ones hands with iron and steel is that the one with open hands may use them for whatever pur

shards of steel strike.name: Shards of Steel Strike
shards of steel strike.text: By targeting vital soft tissues with a pointed,viperhead-like finger jab, the disciple punctures flesh and releases the vital blood supply of his foe all over the ground in a deluge.

steel grapplers attitude.name: Steel Grapplers Attitude
steel grapplers attitude.text: By assuming this stance, the disciple of the Broken Blade has learned to shift his mass and balance to his advantage whengrapplingand running down his foes.

throw the blade down.name: Throw the Blade Down
throw the blade down.text: With a nimble sidestep and sweeping kick, the disciple of the Broken Blade both avoids an attack and uses his attacks momentum to hurl him at the ground to landproneat his feet and at his fading mercy.

finishing kick.name: Finishing Kick
finishing kick.text: Amidst the flurry of punches, kicks, and elbows that are the hallmarks of the Broken Blade discipline, the disciple who has put his foe through the ropes of learning what it is to underestimate the warrior without weapons may deliver this p

pit fighters stance.name: Pit Fighters Stance
pit fighters stance.text: Some disciples have had to use their skills in less than reputable areas, or their teachers have deigned it worthy to learn how to use every opening to your best advantage.

singing steel strike.name: Singing Steel Strike
singing steel strike.text: With a powerful strike to the head of the target, the disciples fist hits as hard as meteoric iron and sets the jaw of the target loose and rings the proverbial bell of the unfortunate who was unlucky to face him.

steel axe kick.name: Steel Axe Kick
steel axe kick.text: With a sweeping axe kick that strikes as hard as anyhammerstrike could ever be hoped to, the disciple of the Broken Blade lands a crushing blow that causes even the strongest of opponents to pause in pain.

adamantine knuckle.name: Adamantine Knuckle
adamantine knuckle.text: The sheer ferocity and focus of the disciples ability in the unarmed combat area rivals that of the greatestkiwielders in the world.

shards of adamantine strike.name: Shards of Adamantine Strike
shards of adamantine strike.text: It is said that masters of the discipline are capable of using their hand in the manner of striking serpent to punch through solid stone as if it were straw, and disciples with this maneuver are those who can.

spinning flurry rush.name: Spinning Flurry Rush
spinning flurry rush.text: The disciple of the Broken Blade takes a deep breath when he finds himself surrounded by opponents and hopes that theyve made peace with the gods, for they will be seeing them soon.

meteoric throw.name: Meteoric Throw
meteoric throw.text: The Broken Blade master has transcended the simple use of his own body as a weapon, and has deigned to use his opponents body as a weapon against those who would stand against him.

spinning adamantine axe.name: Spinning Adamantine Axe
spinning adamantine axe.text: With a powerful leap into the air, the disciple of the Broken Blade unleashes a powerful spinning kick to his surrounding foes that strikes with the force of a hurricane.

unbreakable stride stance.name: Unbreakable Stride Stance
unbreakable stride stance.text: The master of the Broken Blade moves across the theater of war as a leaf on the wind, dodging easily out of the way of obstacles as if they werent even there.

storm of iron fists strike.name: Storm of Iron Fists Strike
storm of iron fists strike.text: The true master of the Broken Blade unleashes a storm ofadamantine-hard strikes that rip through the defenses of his unfortunate target and resound as thunder from the force of the blows.

ensnare.name: Ensnare
ensnare.text: As you strike, you seize the opportunity and grab hold of your foe.

expert grip.name: Expert Grip
expert grip.text: You utilize your skill at carrying yourself to carry your foe much in the same way.

hungry jaws.name: Hungry Jaws
hungry jaws.text: Your bare hands lash out, snagging the target in your clutches.

painbringer.name: Painbringer
painbringer.text: You force yourself onto the opponent while grappling with them, complicating their resistance further.

snatching talons.name: Snatching Talons
snatching talons.text: You adeptly tear through your foes defenses and begin crushing them in your hands.

trampling pin.name: Trampling Pin
trampling pin.text: You slam your foe into the ground with excessive force and hold them down.

agile redirection.name: Agile Redirection
agile redirection.text: You turn a foes momentum against them and shove them across the field.

anaconda's coils.name: Anaconda's Coils
anaconda's coils.text: In a flash, you pounce on your opponent and slam them into the ground, pressing all of your weight on top of them.

bestial dash.name: Bestial Dash
bestial dash.text: Prey in hand, the initiator rushes across the battlefield.

gar rush.name: Gar Rush
gar rush.text: You rush at your quarry and thrash yourself to them as they struggle to avoid you.

catfish hold.name: Catfish Hold
catfish hold.text: Bracing yourself against the terrain, you steel yourself to control and redirect any oncoming assaults.

into the earth.name: Into the Earth
into the earth.text: You slam your prey down at your feet, dealing substantial injury from the force of your throw.

monkey vault.name: Monkey Vault
monkey vault.text: Snagging an opponent, you use them as a base as you vault over or around them.

trapping jaws.name: Trapping Jaws
trapping jaws.text: You snag your opponent in the midst of their attack, refusing to let go.

alligator suplex.name: Alligator Suplex
alligator suplex.text: Wrapping your arms around a grappled target, you slam them into the ground with immense force.

bonebreaker riposte.name: Bonebreaker Riposte
bonebreaker riposte.text: When faced with an attacker, you have learned that your best hope is to incapacitate them, preventing them from further assaults.

magebreaker.name: Magebreaker
magebreaker.text: Some disciples of the Brutal Crocodile have learned pseudo-arcane techniques so as to handle supernaturally tenacious foes.

silencing grip.name: Silencing Grip
silencing grip.text: As you grab hold of the target, you lock their jaw in place so to prevent their resistance.

gut crusher.name: Gut Crusher
gut crusher.text: You smash your opponent in several vulnerable areas, dealing 3d12 damage to the target.

kraken's coils.name: Kraken's Coils
kraken's coils.text: Like a tentacled beast of the deep, you have learned to hold foes in your clutches without the slightest impairment.

meat shield.name: Meat Shield
meat shield.text: An attacker finds its assault intercepted by a hapless creature in your grasp.

voracious maul.name: Voracious Maul
voracious maul.text: Letting loose with your unbridled feral fury, you plunge your armaments repeatedly into the hapless being in your coils.

wing ripper.name: Wing Ripper
wing ripper.text: You bend a grappled targets body in a way that hampers all attempts to move away.

atrophic brutalization.name: Atrophic Brutalization
atrophic brutalization.text: Crippling your foes muscles, you seize hold of your opponent and begin to compact them within your coils.

blood in the water.name: Blood in the Water
blood in the water.text: In a flash of adrenaline, you grab hold of a foe and immediately unleash your feral wrath upon it.

disfiguring gouge.name: Disfiguring Gouge
disfiguring gouge.text: Burrowing your weapon into their face, you inflict severe injury upon your foes countenance.

insatiable warpath.name: Insatiable Warpath
insatiable warpath.text: Your explosive instinct boils over, your ensnared targets becoming implements of destruction.

crushing python.name: Crushing Python
crushing python.text: Seizing hold of the target, you wrap your body around them and begin crushing the life from their fragile form.

dismemberment.name: Dismemberment
dismemberment.text: Roaring furiously, you rip one the limbs from your grapple target, causing blood to come gushing from the wound.

hippo press.name: Hippo Press
hippo press.text: In a smooth motion, you slam your helpless foe into the ground beneath you and prepare yourself to fight off oncoming attackers.

meteoric suplex.name: Meteoric Suplex
meteoric suplex.text: Lunging from the ground at high speed, you slam your target into the dirt, injuring any unfortunate enough to stand in the way.

gorgonops' jaws.name: Gorgonops' Jaws
gorgonops' jaws.text: As you assume a fighting position, your hands tense, prepared to unleash your nightmarish wrestling skills on your victim as soon as your hands take hold.

gorilla backbreaker.name: Gorilla Backbreaker
gorilla backbreaker.text: In a monumental display of grappling, you slam your grappled quarry down and brutalize their body, severely crippling their capacity to act.

impossible hurl.name: Impossible Hurl
impossible hurl.text: Drawing upon the might of your entire body, you heft your target as a massive projectile that flies across the battlefield.

event horizon.name: Event Horizon
event horizon.text: Your grappling abilities operate in more than three dimensions, enabling you to restrain your targets by bending the physical universe itself.

aura of misfortune.name: Aura of Misfortune
aura of misfortune.text: You project an area of ill fortune. While you maintain this stance, all opponents within close range 25 feet + 5 feet per 2 initiator levels take a 2 penalty on saving throws.

luck shifting.name: Luck Shifting
luck shifting.text: One mans ill luck is another mans fortune.

spilled salt.name: Spilled Salt
spilled salt.text: This unsubtle counter disrupts an opponent with a blatant curse, whelming them with misfortune.

stutter strike.name: Stutter Strike
stutter strike.text: With just the faintest edge of dark energies, you can afflict your victims with a word-eating curse.

touch of the witch.name: Touch of the Witch
touch of the witch.text: Your weapons become charged with malicious energies.

woeful burden.name: Woeful Burden
woeful burden.text: This insidious strike leaves a creature burdened with phantom weight that bears them down.

bad karma.name: Bad Karma
bad karma.text: Invoking the basic laws of fortune and punishment, you curse a creature that attempts to harm you.

mockery.name: Mockery
mockery.text: This strike amplifies the misfortune already afflicting an enemy, turning their curse into deep wounds.

murderous spite.name: Murderous Spite
murderous spite.text: You channel your ill will into your attacks.

torment the weak.name: Torment the Weak
torment the weak.text: This vicious strike rends its victims and causes those under your dark power to vent their life force.

word of retribution.name: Word of Retribution
word of retribution.text: With a word you afflict your enemies with the power of your vengeance.

aura of shared misery.name: Aura of Shared Misery
aura of shared misery.text: This baleful aura spreads the despair you inflict and drains at the life of your victims.

dogpile strike.name: Dogpile Strike
dogpile strike.text: This vicious strike preys upon the weak and persecuted.

huntsmans curse.name: Huntsmans Curse
huntsmans curse.text: Creatures struck down by this curse find themselves slowed as though in a nightmare, unable to escape their pursuers.

sorcerers sidestep.name: Sorcerers Sidestep
sorcerers sidestep.text: Drawing on your mystical connection with fortune for good and ill, you avoid even magical and unusual attacks.

hangmans curse.name: Hangmans Curse
hangmans curse.text: This grim curse afflicts its victims with a breathless exhaustion, and a dark bruise forms around their necks.

persecution.name: Persecution
persecution.text: This strike amplifies the misfortune already afflicting an enemy, turning their curse into deep wounds.

warlocks stride.name: Warlocks Stride
warlocks stride.text: Like ill news you travel swiftly, leaving woe and heartbreak in your wake.

witchfinders brand.name: Witchfinders Brand
witchfinders brand.text: With a swift gesture, you impede the sorceries of others.

festering curse.name: Festering Curse
festering curse.text: Your vicious strike afflicts your victims with a curse of rot.

shadow pin.name: Shadow Pin
shadow pin.text: By harming the shadow of your enemy, you can pin them in place.

the dragon knows.name: The Dragon Knows
the dragon knows.text: By meditating on your ill intentions and dark thoughts, you gain senses beyond the normal ken.

witchs revenge.name: Witchs Revenge
witchs revenge.text: This ancient strike utterly cripples a foes abilities.

curse of chains.name: Curse of Chains
curse of chains.text: Phantom chains trail in the wake of your strike and spread through your enemies like wildfire.

eye for an eye.name: Eye for an Eye
eye for an eye.text: With a snarled curse you level vengeance at your enemy.

oathbreakers aura.name: Oathbreakers Aura
oathbreakers aura.text: This malevolent aura robs its victims of theirsupernaturaledges and interferes with their oaths.

sorcerers gaze.name: Sorcerers Gaze
sorcerers gaze.text: By channeling the magical energies within, you pick out the weak places in protections both magical and mundane and strike down those whocowerbehind them.

warlocks blow.name: Warlocks Blow
warlocks blow.text: With a savage curse and a lunge, youteleportyour enemy into your weapon.

black dogs due.name: Black Dogs Due
black dogs due.text: You strike a distracted foe, bringing swift death with the edge of your blade.

traitors roar.name: Traitors Roar
traitors roar.text: Channeling dark energies through your blade, you poison the loyalty of those you strike.

woedrinker.name: Woedrinker
woedrinker.text: Like an avatar of woe, you prosper as others fail.

luckdrinker aura.name: Luckdrinker Aura
luckdrinker aura.text: This cursed aura steals beneficence from your enemies and gifts it to your allies.

unending nightmare strike.name: Unending Nightmare Strike
unending nightmare strike.text: This cruel and unusual strike traps its victims in a waking nightmare.

warlocks mirror.name: Warlocks Mirror
warlocks mirror.text: Those under your influence find their own powers betraying them.

festival of shadows.name: Festival of Shadows
festival of shadows.text: The ultimate expression of your grim power, you wrap your enemies in shadow, plunge your blade into the darkness, striking them down with tenebrous copies of your weapon.

eldritch shield.name: Eldritch Shield
eldritch shield.text: By drawing upon the elements, you are capable of defending against energy effects.

elemental nimbus.name: Elemental Nimbus
elemental nimbus.text: Channeling the strength of the elements lends your attacks strength and fury.

embrace the elements.name: Embrace the Elements
embrace the elements.text: By filing yourself with the fundamentals of an element, you are capable of altering how your body defends itself in the realm of martial combat.

fluctuation movement.name: Fluctuation Movement
fluctuation movement.text: Coating your feet in the power of the elements, you alter your movement to grant you a burst of speed and maneuverability.

spark strike.name: Spark Strike
spark strike.text: By letting the elements flow through you and into your attack, youre able to strike with raw primal energies at your unlucky foe.

variable flux.name: Variable Flux
variable flux.text: Filling your weapon with the power of the elements, you lash out with barely-contained eldritch power.

arcane shield.name: Arcane Shield
arcane shield.text: You rely on your unique insight into eldritch powers to create a shield of energy that protects you from an attack.

degrade resistance.name: Degrade Resistance
degrade resistance.text: As a disciple of the Elemental Flux, you understand how to use elements to assault those normally resistant to them.

eldritch fang.name: Eldritch Fang
eldritch fang.text: You fill your strike with eldritch energy that overwhelms the senses of your target.

elemental strike.name: Elemental Strike
elemental strike.text: You channel the fluctuating power of the elements to land an empowered blow.

energy spark.name: Energy Spark
energy spark.text: You fill the air with elemental energy, which explodes as you strike your target.

elemental flux stance.name: Elemental Flux Stance
elemental flux stance.text: Filling both your body and soul with the power of the elements, you open yourself up to new powers.

energy jolt.name: Energy Jolt
energy jolt.text: You fill the opponent with harmful elemental energy, dealing damage and causing them to suffer debilitating effects.

lance of power.name: Lance of Power
lance of power.text: With a swing of your blade, you release a rippling line of elemental energy.

raging flux.name: Raging Flux
raging flux.text: You know how to strike with such eldritch force that it drives your foes backwards.

arcane torrent.name: Arcane Torrent
arcane torrent.text: You unleash a sudden burst of eldritch energy that surges towards a distant foe.

assay resistance.name: Assay Resistance
assay resistance.text: By directly targeting the elemental essence that suffuses all creatures, you overcome an opponents defenses with a powerful attack.

eldritch consumption.name: Eldritch Consumption
eldritch consumption.text: You have such an intimate understanding of the underlying nature of magic that you can capture its essence and feast on it to rejuvenate yourself.

energy hammer.name: Energy Hammer
energy hammer.text: As you advance your training, you learn to unleash ever more powerful bursts of energy.

elemental drive.name: Elemental Drive
elemental drive.text: You charge your weapon with kinetic and elemental energy, driving them back with a wave of elemental power.

elemental absorption.name: Elemental Absorption
elemental absorption.text: You learn to suffuse your being with an element to such a degree that its presence heals you instead of harming you.

elemental vortex.name: Elemental Vortex
elemental vortex.text: A whirling vortex of elemental energy engulfs your foe just as your blade lands.

enter the vortex.name: Enter the Vortex
enter the vortex.text: Riding on the currents of elemental energy, you gain the benefit of a new form of movement.

eldritch energy hammer.name: Eldritch Energy Hammer
eldritch energy hammer.text: You know how to destroy the bonds that hold magic together just as easily as you can forge them.

elemental destruction ring.name: Elemental Destruction Ring
elemental destruction ring.text: You whip the elements around you into a fury, then unleash the energy at all the foes who surround you.

eldritch fang flurry.name: Eldritch Fang Flurry
eldritch fang flurry.text: Striking at your foes with elemental fury, you aim to disable his opponents in addition to harming them.

nexus of elemental retribution.name: Nexus of Elemental Retribution
nexus of elemental retribution.text: You can absorb and redirect the flow of elemental power, syphoning away energies that would harm you and making them your own.

shatter resistance.name: Shatter Resistance
shatter resistance.text: You know that the might of the elements can overwhelm any defense.

cascade of elemental wrath.name: Cascade of Elemental Wrath
cascade of elemental wrath.text: Each slash of your blade releases more and more eldritch power, overwhelming your enemies with the power of your strikes.

force majeure.name: Force Majeure
force majeure.text: You infuse your weapon with pure elemental power, striking with a force beyond mere steel.

redirecting flux.name: Redirecting Flux
redirecting flux.text: Your mastery of the Elemental Flux discipline knows how to read and alter the flow of magical energy.

elemental breach.name: Elemental Breach
elemental breach.text: As a master of the Elemental Flux discipline, you know how to overwhelm the defenses of your targets and expose their weaknesses to the elements.

master of the elements.name: Master of the Elements
master of the elements.text: You attune your very form to roiling elemental energies and merge with them.

zephyr flux.name: Zephyr Flux
zephyr flux.text: Upon reaching supreme levels of understanding in this discipline, you may transmute your entire being into elemental energy and travel in the blink of an eye across the battlefield, leaving a wake of devastation behind you.

strike of elemental devastation.name: Strike of Elemental Devastation
strike of elemental devastation.text: The ultimate expression of elemental power can only be unleashed by a master of the Elemental Flux discipline, and by calling upon the arcane forces of magic as well as the terrific power of the elements, the disciple may crush his opponent

guards oath.name: Guards Oath
guards oath.text: A central concept of the discipline of the Eternal Guardian is the ability to restrict an opponents movementprevent their escape or halting their advance.

strike of the infinite protector.name: Strike of the Infinite Protector
strike of the infinite protector.text: You swear to protect your charge, while living or dead, with an unbreakable oath.

terrifying blow.name: Terrifying Blow
terrifying blow.text: With a bellowing cry, you deliver a fearsome wound to your opponent.

valiant keepers stance.name: Valiant Keepers Stance
valiant keepers stance.text: The basics of the Eternal Guardian discipline teach you how to ward your allies from errant attacks.

vigilant keepers stance.name: Vigilant Keepers Stance
vigilant keepers stance.text: You adopt an aggressive stance which slows your enemies ability to advance or retreat.

wardens bearing.name: Wardens Bearing
wardens bearing.text: You shift your weight and assume a stronger, more impressive position.

debilitating fear.name: Debilitating Fear
debilitating fear.text: You fill your target with the fear that prey feels when it sees a mighty predator, impairing their ability to act.

fear the reaper.name: Fear the Reaper
fear the reaper.text: You have learned to use the fear you create as a method of defense for both yourself and your allies.

oath of the intercessor.name: Oath of the Intercessor
oath of the intercessor.text: You make an unbreakable vow to take the brunt of an attack in place of your ally.

strike of the royal guardian.name: Strike of the Royal Guardian
strike of the royal guardian.text: Some foes may slip past your guard, but as a disciple of the Eternal Guardian, you have other ways to minimize their threat, afflicting your enemies with an agonizing curse that cripples their attacks.

relentless wardens strike.name: Relentless Wardens Strike
relentless wardens strike.text: You hound a weakened enemy, keeping them in check.

binding fetters.name: Binding Fetters
binding fetters.text: Your oath binds you and the target of your attack in combat with each other, leashing your very souls together.

intruders end.name: Intruders End
intruders end.text: You declare an area to be your protected sanctum, and dare any foe to try their hand at entering your sanctum.

stance of the eternal guardian.name: Stance of the Eternal Guardian
stance of the eternal guardian.text: You bind your soul in a protective embrace around one of your allies.

swallow your fear.name: Swallow Your Fear
swallow your fear.text: Your knowledge of fear and devotion allows you to absorb and control harmful magics which can affect the mind.

grim guards laughter.name: Grim Guards Laughter
grim guards laughter.text: Your deep, disturbing laughter echoes throughout the battlefield filling your foes with dread and causing their wills to falter.

oath of torpor.name: Oath of Torpor
oath of torpor.text: You swear an oath to your foes, that their limbs will be heavy and their wills sapped.

strike of the steadfast legion.name: Strike of the Steadfast Legion
strike of the steadfast legion.text: When you bring your enemy low, your strength bolsters the will of your allies.

watchmans rebuke.name: Watchmans Rebuke
watchmans rebuke.text: Your supernatural will calls for your enemies to cease resisting and submit to your judgement.

jailer of the damned.name: Jailer of the Damned
jailer of the damned.text: You adopt the stance of the wardens which guard the gates of death.

unbearable gaze.name: Unbearable Gaze
unbearable gaze.text: Your stare fills a creature with supernatural dread, causing them to fear looking into your eyes lest it cause them great harm.

shackles of the condemned.name: Shackles of the Condemned
shackles of the condemned.text: Your strike binds your target, summoning cursed manacles that bind both you and your enemy to a single fate.

stand your ground.name: Stand Your Ground
stand your ground.text: You and your ally stand together to defend your position, strengthened by supernatural resolve.

charge of dismay.name: Charge of Dismay
charge of dismay.text: The disciple barrels through the enemy lines, terrifying his foes.

inescapable fetters.name: Inescapable Fetters
inescapable fetters.text: Your nightmarish oath that no foe will escape you draws.

inescapable grasp.name: Inescapable Grasp
inescapable grasp.text: Your resolution is absolute, and those affected by your ill will find themselves unable to act freely.

infinite focus.name: Infinite Focus
infinite focus.text: You share some of your patience and dedication with your allies, allowing them to avoid careless mistakes that would allow an opponent to strike.

strike of sacrifice.name: Strike of Sacrifice
strike of sacrifice.text: You seal a portion of your life force around your allies, protecting them from harm at the cost of your own vulnerability.

curse of impending doom maneuver.name: Curse of Impending Doom maneuver
curse of impending doom maneuver.text: The disciples curse seeps into the foes subconscious, forcing it to believe failure is just around the corner.

grim satisfaction.name: Grim Satisfaction
grim satisfaction.text: Seeing the fear and resignation in the eyes of your foes spurs you closer to victory.

unbreakable promise.name: Unbreakable Promise
unbreakable promise.text: You vow that no foe will land a killing blow against those under your protection.

crushing rebuke.name: Crushing Rebuke
crushing rebuke.text: Your overwhelming presence castigates a foe, causing them to utterly doubt their own abilities.

hammer of the immortal.name: Hammer of the Immortal
hammer of the immortal.text: You act as both hammer and anvil, striking your enemies with furious skill that breaks their lines and their spirits.

stance of the infinite warrior.name: Stance of the Infinite Warrior
stance of the infinite warrior.text: Your eternal vigilance allows you to leave an echo of your presence behind to guard areas in which you are no longer physically present.

oath of eternity.name: Oath of Eternity
oath of eternity.text: You declare a swathe of the battlefield to be your domain, in which you will brook no trespass.

iron grip.name: Iron Grip
iron grip.text: The most basic technique of the Fools Errand discipline is simple: grab hold, and dont let go.

lesson i: balance.name: Lesson I: Balance
lesson i: balance.text: The first lesson a Fools Errand trainee is taught is merely to stand.

lesson ii: control.name: Lesson II: Control
lesson ii: control.text: The second important lesson you learned was to understand and tightly grasp the flow of combat to negate the movements of your enemies.

lock step.name: Lock Step
lock step.text: You match your enemys movements, preventing them from acting freely.

one-two punch.name: One-Two Punch
one-two punch.text: With quick footwork and equally-quick fists, you deliver a pair of deadly blows.

whirlwind sweep.name: Whirlwind Sweep
whirlwind sweep.text: You spin, sweeping your targets legs while at the same time using your momentum to grab and throw them.

bob and weave.name: Bob and Weave
bob and weave.text: You duck under your opponents guard, delivering an attack in their blind spot.

death at ten paces.name: Death at Ten Paces
death at ten paces.text: Though a combination of immense speed and honed skill, you can use wind pressure to strike a target at a distance.

lead and follow.name: Lead and Follow
lead and follow.text: Battle is a dance, and you happen to know all the steps.

hurricane kick.name: Hurricane Kick
hurricane kick.text: With a powerful leap and a twist, you take brief flight, before crashing down with a deadly blow.

steel-shattering fists.name: Steel-Shattering Fists
steel-shattering fists.text: Ceaseless training breaking boards and shattering plates of stone and steel have taught you how best to strike hard surfaces.

adamantine grip.name: Adamantine Grip
adamantine grip.text: After striking with your weapon, you follow with an iron grip.

lesson iii: supression.name: Lesson III: Supression
lesson iii: supression.text: The third chapter in your training taught you to assert and maintain pressure on the field of battle.

the best weapon is theirs.name: The Best Weapon is Theirs
the best weapon is theirs.text: As a disciple of the Fools Errand discipline, you are taught to never rely on your body alonethough you are a deadly weapon, a sword is deadlier.

windmill waltz flurry.name: Windmill Waltz Flurry
windmill waltz flurry.text: You dance across the battlefield, delivering a quick series of blows with weapon and body alike.

make them humble.name: Make Them Humble
make them humble.text: Your training has shown you that while magic is an advantage, it is not insurmountable if you simply apply enough brute force.

night falls.name: Night Falls
night falls.text: Open combat is not your only battlefieldyou are also adept at ending fights before they start.

the sincerest form of flattery.name: The Sincerest Form of Flattery
the sincerest form of flattery.text: You can initiate this counter in response to a maneuver not a stance being initiated by another creature you can see.

tornado slam.name: Tornado Slam
tornado slam.text: You deliver a brutal blow that blasts the target away, then give them no respite before following up with further attacks.

blade-dance ballet.name: Blade-Dance Ballet
blade-dance ballet.text: You follow a slash of your sword with several quick jabs or kicks.

lesson iv: the ladder.name: Lesson IV: The Ladder
lesson iv: the ladder.text: Your first lesson was how to fall; your fourth lesson is how to not.

moment of mastery.name: Moment of Mastery
moment of mastery.text: You deliver a series of perfectly-placed parries against your foes attacks.

surround from within.name: Surround from Within
surround from within.text: You cleverly place yourself in a position to strike at all enemies.

flowing dance of the fool.name: Flowing Dance of the Fool
flowing dance of the fool.text: With a blindingly-fast sprint, you drag an opponent into a vicious combination attack.

lesson v: expression.name: Lesson V: Expression
lesson v: expression.text: Th fifth lesson you learned expanded on the precepts and concepts of the earlier teachings.

no escape.name: No Escape
no escape.text: You swiftly react to your opponents movements, redoubling your grip or following their path.

tempest tango blitz.name: Tempest Tango Blitz
tempest tango blitz.text: You mix attacks with your body and attacks with your weapon to carve a whirling path through your enemies.

to the skies.name: To the Skies
to the skies.text: With a mighty effort, you entrust those in your grip to the sky.

finger of god.name: Finger of God
finger of god.text: Every sword on the battlefield is your weapon, even if your foes happen to be holding them for safekeeping.

lightning strike twice.name: Lightning Strike Twice
lightning strike twice.text: Your blow reverberates through the targets body, echoing again moments after you strike.

utter commitment.name: Utter Commitment
utter commitment.text: Your dedication to your training and determination to exceed has brought you past the normal limits.

endless dance of death.name: Endless Dance of Death
endless dance of death.text: There is seemingly no end to your assault.

lesson vi: supremacy.name: Lesson VI: Supremacy
lesson vi: supremacy.text: As a master of your art, you can fluidly combine the styles of the Fools Errand discipline with the others youve studied and trained in.

sky-shattering throw.name: Sky-Shattering Throw
sky-shattering throw.text: You grip your opponent and throw them, converting all of your strength into their momentum.

proof of victory.name: Proof of Victory
proof of victory.text: At its heart, the Fools Errand discipline is founded on stolen ideas.

demoralizing roar.name: Demoralizing Roar
demoralizing roar.text: With a shout of rage and defiance, the Golden Lion disciple wades into battle with fearless determination, shattering the resolve of his foes.

encouraging roar.name: Encouraging Roar
encouraging roar.text: The disciple lets out shouts of encouragement to bolster his allies in battle.

hunting party.name: Hunting Party
hunting party.text: When two or more soldiers converge on a single target, the odds of victory increase and the disciple with the knowledge of this strike can assist his comrades potential lethality.

pride leaders stance.name: Pride Leaders Stance
pride leaders stance.text: By adopting the mannerisms of commanding lions of the great savannahs, the disciple inspires heroics by his presence.

pride movement.name: Pride Movement
pride movement.text: By having a watchful eye on the flow of combat, the disciple knows when to spur an ally into a better position.

tactical strike.name: Tactical Strike
tactical strike.text: Any commander knows that in battle, footwork is key.

call to action.name: Call to Action
call to action.text: With a mighty blow, the disciple aids an ally by providing an opening in combat to move by an opponent.

defending the pride.name: Defending the Pride
defending the pride.text: With a cry to defend themselves from incoming attacks, the inspirational words of the disciple aid his allies in their defense.

distracting strike.name: Distracting Strike
distracting strike.text: By attracting the attentions of a foe with a well-placed and vicious blow, the disciple of the Golden Lion may distract and weaken his foe to the predations of his allies.

pyrite strike.name: Pyrite Strike
pyrite strike.text: With a powerful strike, the Golden Lion disciple pushes his foe into the waiting arms of his allies and their hungry blades.

warning roar.name: Warning Roar
warning roar.text: Witnessing a clear and present danger to an ally, the disciple shouts out a well-timed warning and aids his ally in defending against an attack.

circling the prey.name: Circling the Prey
circling the prey.text: With practiced precision and a quick shout, the disciple and his allies move in unison for better strategic advantage.

golden commander stance.name: Golden Commander Stance
golden commander stance.text: Through the use of the Golden Lion disciples superior tactical ability, he is able to direct his allies in combat for maximum effectiveness.

kill the wounded.name: Kill the Wounded
kill the wounded.text: The Golden Lion disciple makes a ferocious assault on his foe, opening the enemys defenses to the attacks of his allies.

pack pounce.name: Pack Pounce
pack pounce.text: By capitalizing on the opportunities granted by the presence of his allies who are attacking his foe, the lethality of the Golden Lion disciple increases dramatically due to his knowledge of pack tactics.

charge of the battle cat.name: Charge of the Battle Cat
charge of the battle cat.text: Like the charge of the mighty lion as he takes his prey to the ground, the Golden Lion disciple charges into battle, heedless of his enemies, to crash into his chosen foe with a mighty strike, knocking him to the ground at his feet.

direct the pride.name: Direct the Pride
direct the pride.text: Cooperation and teamwork form the backbone of tactical warfare, and through his knowledge of all of these things, the Golden Lion disciple may help direct the actions of his ally to greater effectiveness.

golden lion charger.name: Golden Lion Charger
golden lion charger.text: A student of the art of war and of the Golden Lion, a disciple who has training in the art of engaging an enemy knows that sometimes a powerful opening charge can be the edge the warrior needs.

golden swipe.name: Golden Swipe
golden swipe.text: With a series of furious blows against his foe, the Golden Lion disciple batters his opponent into the waiting blades of his allies.

discipline of the pride.name: Discipline of the Pride
discipline of the pride.text: Through training with his allies, the disciple has taught them the basics of his military skill that they may call upon in times of duress.

guard the pride.name: Guard the Pride
guard the pride.text: By trusting the awareness of the celestial realm, the discipline trusts in his heavenly sense of the battle around him to see where the next attack is coming and move away from danger.

roar of battle.name: Roar of Battle
roar of battle.text: The Golden Lion disciple delivers a telling blow, shattering bones and piercing defenses alike as he presses the foe into opening vital places for his allies to gain purchase.

strategic blow.name: Strategic Blow
strategic blow.text: With a tremendous strike, the disciple confuses the enemy and creates an opening for an ally to reposition himself.

endurance of the strong.name: Endurance of the Strong
endurance of the strong.text: Allies falling in combat weakens the core of the unit, so when an ally is injured, it is up to the commanding presence of the Golden Lion disciple to bolster his fallen comrades.

golden generals attitude.name: Golden Generals Attitude
golden generals attitude.text: A true Golden Lion disciple is a beacon of command on the field of battle, inspiring his troops by his mere presence.

harry the prey.name: Harry the Prey
harry the prey.text: Through coordinated tactics, the comrades at a Golden Lion disciples side may act as one.

lions feast.name: Lions Feast
lions feast.text: As the thrill of a successful hunt invigorates a pride of lions on the plains, so does the thrill of victory over foes invigorate the disciples allies.

golden generals victory.name: Golden Generals Victory
golden generals victory.text: The power and majesty of the lion lords of the wild lives within the disciple, so much so that his victories are a victory for all of his allies.

orichalcum swipe.name: Orichalcum Swipe
orichalcum swipe.text: A Golden Lion disciple shapes the very nature of war, and this technique allows him to direct his foes through his allies blades as easily as a knife through bread.

war lions charge.name: War Lions Charge
war lions charge.text: With the ferocity of an angered lion, the Golden Lion disciple races across the battlefield ignoring secondary targets to bear down on a single enemy and reduce him to dust.

alphas roar.name: Alphas Roar
alphas roar.text: With an awesome cry for victory and bravery from his allies, the Golden Lion disciple bolsters allies defenses and attacks for a moment as his allies cannot help themselves but to win.

lion lords agony.name: Lion Lords Agony
lion lords agony.text: With a fury born of desperation and determination for victory, the Golden Lion disciple pours his pain into his swings so that the enemy may drink deeply of it.

triumphant lions leadership.name: Triumphant Lions Leadership
triumphant lions leadership.text: A beacon of victory upon the field of combat, the disciple personifies glory in combat and those in his presence may share in his prowess.

lord of the pridelands.name: Lord of the Pridelands
lord of the pridelands.text: Proving he is the undisputed master of war, the Golden Lion master calls for absolute and crushing victory through overwhelming force of numbers.

angering smash.name: Angering Smash
angering smash.text: By making a quick shield bash, the disciple taunts and aggravates his foes into striking at him solely.

iron shell.name: Iron Shell
iron shell.text: A shield is used for defense primarily, a basic martial truth.

snapping strike.name: Snapping Strike
snapping strike.text: Disciples of the Iron Tortoise school learn basics of the style, and that is to keep ones shield high and ones weapon low.

snapping turtle stance.name: Snapping Turtle Stance
snapping turtle stance.text: The disciple of the Iron Tortoise in this stance holds his shield in a manner to deliver punishing shield bashes without sacrificing his ability to defend himself.

stance of the defending shell.name: Stance of the Defending Shell
stance of the defending shell.text: An Iron Tortoise disciple learns a valuable stance that forms the core of their discipline, that being the nature of the unbreakable wall.

throwing shell.name: Throwing Shell
throwing shell.text: Using a special technique developed for surprisingly effective ranged attacks, the disciple of the Iron Tortoise knows how to deliver his shield in a powerful throw in a manner similar to a champion discus thrower.

defensive shell.name: Defensive Shell
defensive shell.text: The Iron Tortoise disciple has quick reflexes and a strong shield with which to defend his allies.

enduring shell.name: Enduring Shell
enduring shell.text: By tightening up behind his shield and dropping low under its protective aegis, the disciple of the Iron Tortoise learns to minimize the risk he suffers from spells and effects that would cause him to rely solely on reflexes.

enraging strike.name: Enraging Strike
enraging strike.text: The defensive nature of the Iron Tortoise teaches the disciple to protect his allies, and to do so, he must focus the attentions of his foes on him.

tactical snap.name: Tactical Snap
tactical snap.text: The turtle, when it on its back, is helpless to defend itself and is immobilized unless it can right itself.

taunting turtle.name: Taunting Turtle
taunting turtle.text: The initiator singles out an enemy on the field of battlefield and through words, postures, or gestures insults and infuriates the foe to attack him on its next available action with whatever means it possesses.

burnished shell.name: Burnished Shell
burnished shell.text: By angling ones shield correctly and stepping into an enemy spells effect, he may deflect the power of the spell that targets him.

greater snapping strike.name: Greater Snapping Strike
greater snapping strike.text: A decisive strike is often times what ends a battle or duel, and the disciple of the Iron Tortoise knows to keep his wits about him and wait for the moment to strike hard and strike true.

iron tortoise stance.name: Iron Tortoise Stance
iron tortoise stance.text: This stance allows the disciple of the Iron Tortoise greater offensive ability while still remaining on the defensive, protecting himself and his allies.

tortoise defense.name: Tortoise Defense
tortoise defense.text: By focusing on defense, the disciple sacrifices his movement speed for greater protection.

aggravated wounds.name: Aggravated Wounds
aggravated wounds.text: By making aggravating wounds and aggressive, intimidating postures, the disciples attacks possess an unusual amount of threatening power.

ricochet shell.name: Ricochet Shell
ricochet shell.text: By hurling his shield at his foes with the speed and force of a giant-tossed boulder, the disciple of the Iron Tortoise bounces his shield between a few targets with rapid speed and punishing force.

smashing shell.name: Smashing Shell
smashing shell.text: The Iron Tortoise disciple is a master of using his shield both for offense and defense.

snapping riposte.name: Snapping Riposte
snapping riposte.text: By searching for openings in an opponents defenses when they reach to attack, the Iron Tortoise disciple learns to strike through this opening to score a vicious wound.

quick snap.name: Quick Snap
quick snap.text: Inevitably, a warrior will receive a wound in battle, and when that happens, those skilled in the ways of the Iron Tortoise make the best of it.

shell shock.name: Shell Shock
shell shock.text: The Iron Tortoise disciple has in his arsenal a stout shield and strong arms, and a will to decisively win a battle.

turtle knights stance.name: Turtle Knights Stance
turtle knights stance.text: By planting his feet, staying low to the ground with his shield at the ready, the martial disciple roots himself firmly in place, immovable.

vicious snapping strike.name: Vicious Snapping Strike
vicious snapping strike.text: A skilled disciple of the Iron Tortoise knows the secrets to slowing his opponents down to match his heavily armored speed.

mithral tortoise stance.name: Mithral Tortoise Stance
mithral tortoise stance.text: The Iron Tortoise disciple has become so comfortable in his armor that is like a second skin to him, and he is capable of moving better than most while wearing it.

snapping turtle rush.name: Snapping Turtle Rush
snapping turtle rush.text: By charging forward to gain momentum, the martial disciple may make a powerful shield bash that may knock his foes to the ground, crippled with injuries.

steel shell.name: Steel Shell
steel shell.text: By steeling himself against an attack behind the wall of his mighty shield, an Iron Tortoise disciple may attempt to negate or reduce an incoming attack.

throwing shell cyclone.name: Throwing Shell Cyclone
throwing shell cyclone.text: The disciple of the Iron Tortoise levels his shield out and spins, releasing it to strike out as his foes in a flurry of clanging steel as it ricochets mercilessly against all within his range and lands firmly back in his waiting hand.

cyclonic shell crush.name: Cyclonic Shell Crush
cyclonic shell crush.text: By making a wide, spinning strike with his shield, the Iron Tortoise master may bash all foes who surround him, teaching them that while he may be surrounded, he will not give up without a fight.

iron defenders riposte.name: Iron Defenders Riposte
iron defenders riposte.text: The Iron Tortoise master is wary of the danger to his charges that his enemies represent, and he is ready to spring into motion to defend them.

unlimited aggression.name: Unlimited Aggression
unlimited aggression.text: By assuming an aggressive posture and taunting his foes, the Iron Tortoise challenges all foes to face him if they dare.

adamantine shell.name: Adamantine Shell
adamantine shell.text: By seemingly empowering his shield with his will and perfectly setting himself against an attack, the Iron Tortoise master may attempt to render almost any attack against his person harmless.

glorious shell shock.name: Glorious Shell Shock
glorious shell shock.text: By sweeping his shield in a deadly arc, the martial disciple may send up to three adjacent foes flying away with bone-shattering force.

turtle generals stance.name: Turtle Generals Stance
turtle generals stance.text: This stance represents the Iron Tortoise warriors ability for self sacrifice for the defense of others.

invulnerable shell of the iron tortoise.name: Invulnerable Shell of the Iron Tortoise
invulnerable shell of the iron tortoise.text: The ultimate technique of the Iron Tortoise discipline, the master of this discipline learns to use his unbreakable will to bolster his shield to defend himself and his allies from any attack.

climactic butchery.name: Climactic Butchery
climactic butchery.text: You drive your weapon deep into the foe, ensuring that it wont be getting up any time soon.

cruel hyenas facade.name: Cruel Hyenas Facade
cruel hyenas facade.text: Assuming a swaggering gait, you perplex and destabilize foes with your movements.

false command.name: False Command
false command.text: Assuming a tone of authority, you bark a misleading order at a creature within range.

incite betrayal.name: Incite Betrayal
incite betrayal.text: Spurring the target into a fit of rage, you send them against their own ally.

malignant punisher stance.name: Malignant Punisher Stance
malignant punisher stance.text: You brace yourself to evade oncoming attacks and to injure those who fail to hit you.

savaging steel.name: Savaging Steel
savaging steel.text: Your steel cuts into your foe, opening deep wounds in their body.

face me.name: Face Me
face me.text: With a snarl, you cow your opponents out of trying to escape.

sadistic vitality.name: Sadistic Vitality
sadistic vitality.text: Like a ravenous beast, you feed off the destruction your weapons cause.

tear banner.name: Tear Banner
tear banner.text: The injury inflicted by your attack shakes the faith of other creatures around the target.

weight of defeat.name: Weight of Defeat
weight of defeat.text: You guard against a foes attack, goading them in to stop them from protecting themselves.

wound-gouging blade.name: Wound-Gouging Blade
wound-gouging blade.text: Your weapon buries itself in the wounds of your foe, amplifying their suffering by several factors.

erode resolve.name: Erode Resolve
erode resolve.text: Striking a critical point, you halt a foe in their tracks.

leverage dismay.name: Leverage Dismay
leverage dismay.text: Drawing upon your opponents unease, you lash out against them with the force of many threats at once.

precarious doubt.name: Precarious Doubt
precarious doubt.text: You unleash a terrific display that discombobulates nearby creatures into staying out of your reach.

riot of despair.name: Riot of Despair
riot of despair.text: You become the incarnation of your foes ruin, bringing down upon them all the mistakes that they have made and driving them back.

bring to knee.name: Bring to Knee
bring to knee.text: Striking a low blow against your opponent, you take them off their feet and dispose of their fighting ability temporarily.

cackling mockery.name: Cackling Mockery
cackling mockery.text: You steel yourself against an attack and laugh off the injury, forcing the target to press the assault against you in spite of themself.

foment helplessness.name: Foment Helplessness
foment helplessness.text: Mocking your opponents feeble efforts, you instill within them a great deal of self-doubt that hampers their combat abilities.

pinning iron.name: Pinning Iron
pinning iron.text: You attempt to run your opponent through with a weapon, trapping them in place.

brutal misdirection.name: Brutal Misdirection
brutal misdirection.text: Before your foe can put down their weapon, you deceive them into attacking another target.

dastards blades.name: Dastards Blades
dastards blades.text: You disquiet your target around its allies, taking the opportunity to launch your weapon deep into a vulnerable point.

feed on unease.name: Feed on Unease
feed on unease.text: The moans and curses of your enemies are like a song to your ears, fueling you with passion to finally end their misery.

isolating blow.name: Isolating Blow
isolating blow.text: The agonizing ringing of your weapons in your opponent halts them from listening to or communicating with their allies.

standing death.name: Standing Death
standing death.text: You place yourself in a position where you seem to constantly threaten creatures, even if you cannot do anything.

conviction breaker.name: Conviction Breaker
conviction breaker.text: Tearing through your opponent with untamed voracity and sadism, you hammer out a rhythm that continually weakens their resolve.

scavengers leer.name: Scavengers Leer
scavengers leer.text: You grin mirthfully at your opponent, making them second-guess their action.

fight-taking steel.name: Fight-Taking Steel
fight-taking steel.text: Your foe becomes wholly rattled as its body is torn apart, its might pouring from every gash in its body.

stance of sown mistrust.name: Stance of Sown Mistrust
stance of sown mistrust.text: You distill away any sense of camaraderie or trust that your foes possess, replacing it with dread.

cackling madness.name: Cackling Madness
cackling madness.text: With raving madness that deprives even hardened soldiers of their wits, you turn the oncoming tide of opponents against each other.

crippling wound.name: Crippling Wound
crippling wound.text: Inflicting a massive and strategically-placed wound, you leave your target pouring blood as they become increasingly weaker.

malfeasant deception.name: Malfeasant Deception
malfeasant deception.text: Dodging through a foes attack in a dramatic and impressive manner, you render your other attackers unprepared for what happens next.

kingbreaker.name: Kingbreaker
kingbreaker.text: Few things rattle an army quite like seeing one of their own struck down, and you capitalize upon this fact ruthlessly.

leaden hyena stance.name: Leaden Hyena Stance
leaden hyena stance.text: The grotesque saunter of your movements causes foes around you to constantly second-guess their abilities, bringing about defeat from within.

poisoned will.name: Poisoned Will
poisoned will.text: War is the ultimate desecration of ones mind, and as the bloodshed continues a victim only becomes more unstable.

taste of defeat.name: Taste of Defeat
taste of defeat.text: With a mischievous glare, you leave a target thinking that their demise is inevitable, breaking their will to fight.

make it work.name: Make it Work
make it work.text: With a sudden surge of supernatural inspiration, you find a workaround to the faults of any equipment you carry.

quick-fingered draw.name: Quick-Fingered Draw
quick-fingered draw.text: You keep your hands primed to seize any piece of equipment you possess from your person quickly.

sabotage.name: Sabotage
sabotage.text: Seizing an opening, you target the weakest points on your opponents equipment.

short out.name: Short Out
short out.text: You unleash a disruptive pulse which inhibits normal function of abilities.

steelscrapper's attitude.name: Steelscrapper's Attitude
steelscrapper's attitude.text: You glean vulnerabilities in the weapons of your enemies, figuring out how to easily render them ineffective.

thump the engine.name: Thump the Engine
thump the engine.text: Unsatisfied with your result, you give an item an additional kick of power.

breakers dodge.name: Breakers Dodge
breakers dodge.text: As a foe raises their weaponry, you intercept their attack by going after their equipment.

energy retention.name: Energy Retention
energy retention.text: You imbue an object with a coating of energy that enables it to be used without diminishing its internal energies.

delaying defiance.name: Delaying Defiance
delaying defiance.text: As a surge of energy is unleashed, you suppress its effects for a brief duration.

jam the gears.name: Jam the Gears
jam the gears.text: Your attack inhibits the movement of some crucial component in a machine, arcane pattern, or even a creatures body.

shutdown shot.name: Shutdown Shot
shutdown shot.text: You unleash a burst of energy with your attack which renders their magical and mechanical abilities ineffectual.

emergency application.name: Emergency Application
emergency application.text: Rapidly, you procure and activate an item in your employ.

mangled gear stance.name: Mangled Gear Stance
mangled gear stance.text: You activate a signal which makes the usage of equipment or magic difficult.

optimum performance.name: Optimum Performance
optimum performance.text: You create an energy field around a weapon which enables it to perform to its greatest potential.

repurpose power.name: Repurpose Power
repurpose power.text: As energy flows towards you, you attempt to redirect it into your equipment.

conductive retaliation.name: Conductive Retaliation
conductive retaliation.text: As an energy attack comes towards you, you manipulate the energy to fire it back at your assailant.

saboteurs guile.name: Saboteurs Guile
saboteurs guile.text: You analyze a foes equipment and pinpoint its weakest point, enabling you to easily deal immense damage to it.

shatter the barrier.name: Shatter the Barrier
shatter the barrier.text: You launch an attack at a foe or object with the aim to cripple its defenses.

systemic bypass.name: Systemic Bypass
systemic bypass.text: You create an energy field around yourself which blocks divinatory and protective effects, enabling you to move through them with ease.

battle tinker's parry.name: Battle Tinker's Parry
battle tinker's parry.text: Just as you have learned to destroy others equipment, you have figured out how to fortify your own.

blackout blitz.name: Blackout Blitz
blackout blitz.text: You rush across the battlefield with tools in hand, tearing apart anything in your way.

don’t die on me.name: Don’t Die On Me
don’t die on me.text: You pump a surge of energy through a piece of equipment, enabling it to perform normally in spite of problematic circumstances.

energy scavenger.name: Energy Scavenger
energy scavenger.text: Your attack disrupts the energies around your target, releasing them and enabling you to use them for yourself.

energized doom.name: Energized Doom
energized doom.text: You overload a weapon with energy, causing it to consume energy at an unusual speed but become much more potent.

failsafe reserves.name: Failsafe Reserves
failsafe reserves.text: You shield yourself against effects which would disrupt the normal function of your equipment.

lockdown strike.name: Lockdown Strike
lockdown strike.text: You channel a disruptive burst of energy through your attack, either rendering a piece of equipment or a creatures body nonfunctional.

redirect energy.name: Redirect Energy
redirect energy.text: Sensing an oncoming attack, you steer it towards another target.

fearsome backfire.name: Fearsome Backfire
fearsome backfire.text: Sensing the eldritch or electrical energies at work, you quickly disrupt them to violently harm their user.

scrapper's glee.name: Scrapper's Glee
scrapper's glee.text: You let loose with a brutal flurry of attacks with the intent to decimate your opponents arsenal.

second surge.name: Second Surge
second surge.text: You cause a burst of power which replicates a recent effect.

full overdrive.name: Full Overdrive
full overdrive.text: You amplify the effects of magical and technological equipment you carry, making them absurdly powerful for a short duration.

keep the flame alive.name: Keep the Flame Alive
keep the flame alive.text: You produce a constant outflow of energy from your body, keeping your equipment in peak shape.

shockwave breakdown.name: Shockwave Breakdown
shockwave breakdown.text: As you strike an object, you overcharge it with energy so that it explodes an violently disrupts any nearby equipment.

total shutdown.name: Total Shutdown
total shutdown.text: Your attack sends a powerful energy field coursing through the target, rendering their equipment and enhancements ineffectual.

flowing creek.name: Flowing Creek
flowing creek.text: Like the flowing water that inspired your art, you sidestep and work around foes instead of fighting them directly.

following wake.name: Following Wake
following wake.text: By utilizing the momentum of your body and blade, you turn a charge into disabling slash that leaves your opponent on the ground.

reaching blade stance.name: Reaching Blade Stance
reaching blade stance.text: You can translate the momentum of your swift attacks into greater reach, striking foes who would normally be out of your range.

ready the draw.name: Ready the Draw
ready the draw.text: You have the ability to draw your weapon with blinding speed, channeling that motion into deadly attacks.

swift current.name: Swift Current
swift current.text: One of the basic tenets of the Mithral Current is that all momentum can be turned into a powerful offensive tool.

tidal blade.name: Tidal Blade
tidal blade.text: As a disciple of the Mithral Current discipline, your skill and grace comes from your flowing movements and lightning-quick attacks.

calm the storm.name: Calm the Storm
calm the storm.text: By perfectly timing your counterattacks, you can force your opponent into a position where they are unable to further attack you.

dual crash.name: Dual Crash
dual crash.text: With a sudden reversal of direction, you strike an enemy when they least expect itat the instant after theyd already been hit.

iron wave.name: Iron Wave
iron wave.text: By imitating the motions of ocean waves, you extend the reach of your blade beyond its edge.

ride the wake.name: Ride the Wake
ride the wake.text: For a disciple of the Mithral Current discipline, stillness is death, and you acknowledge this fact by continuing to move even after striking your foes.

riptide strike.name: Riptide Strike
riptide strike.text: Like the dangerous tidal swells that pull swimmers out to sea and under the waves, you pull an opponent to the ground with your strike.

flowing water stance.name: Flowing Water Stance
flowing water stance.text: You adopt a stance that maximizes free movement and speed, allowing you to dance around your opponents attacks and flow past obstacles like a rushing stream.

rippling current.name: Rippling Current
rippling current.text: Your blade weaves in and out of your opponents sight to strike at an unexpected angle.

rushing wake.name: Rushing Wake
rushing wake.text: With a sudden burst of speed, you charge towards a foe, skillfully knocking aside any others in your path.

salt breeze strike.name: Salt Breeze Strike
salt breeze strike.text: Imitating the stinging winds of ocean storms, you strike with a debilitating slash and a spray of dust.

blinding reflection.name: Blinding Reflection
blinding reflection.text: Reflecting light of your blade like a pond bathed in moonlight, you temporarily blind an opponent and swiftly strike in the opening granted.

disruptive wave.name: Disruptive Wave
disruptive wave.text: By sensing the ripples in reality caused by powerful magic, you are able to anticipate and strike before a spell takes effect.

ride the current.name: Ride the Current
ride the current.text: By reading the movements of a foe, you are able to position yourself out of your enemys reach, striking as a final parting gift.

silver wave.name: Silver Wave
silver wave.text: Drawing your blade in a powerful diagonal cut, you strike your foe with a brutal wave of kinetic energy.

flowing stream.name: Flowing Stream
flowing stream.text: Your graceful movements allow you to distance yourself from enemies attacks.

mithral flash.name: Mithral Flash
mithral flash.text: Though the Mithral Current discipline is noted for its graceful movements and artful dodges, you are just as capable of blocking blades as you are avoiding them.

rapid current.name: Rapid Current
rapid current.text: You unleash a rapid flurry of attacks at an enemy, carving deep wounds into their flesh.

shifting waters stance.name: Shifting Waters Stance
shifting waters stance.text: You dance your way across the battlefield, heedless of any obstacles between you and your target.

whirlpool strike.name: Whirlpool Strike
whirlpool strike.text: With a spinning slash, you strike down all foes near you.

crashing wake.name: Crashing Wake
crashing wake.text: You rush across the battlefield, striking all foes in your path.

endless current.name: Endless Current
endless current.text: You channel the momentum of your attacks into a leaping dance, allowing you to maneuver across the battlefield with every blow.

mithral current stance.name: Mithral Current Stance
mithral current stance.text: You move with the speed and grace of a rapid flowing river, striking at blinding speeds.

quicksilver wave.name: Quicksilver Wave
quicksilver wave.text: A wave of silver energy leaps from your blade to slash at a distant foe.

blade of the silver sea.name: Blade of the Silver Sea
blade of the silver sea.text: Your blade ripples and shimmers with a bright silver light as it strikes home and rends the flesh of your enemy.

flowing river.name: Flowing River
flowing river.text: The dance of the Mithral Current allows you to avoid an incoming effect and return the insult with great fury.

raging whirlpool strike.name: Raging Whirlpool Strike
raging whirlpool strike.text: With a whirling slash, you carve through all foes that presume to approach you.

mithral lightning stance.name: Mithral Lightning Stance
mithral lightning stance.text: With blinding movements and rapid, graceful strikes, you are able to travel across the battlefield and bring death to any who would try to oppose you.

mithral wave.name: Mithral Wave
mithral wave.text: A wave of blinding silver energy erupts from your blade to strike a distant foe.

riptide slice.name: Riptide Slice
riptide slice.text: As a master of the Mithral Current discipline, you can make a cut so light and gentle it feels like a mere breeze while still rending your enemy to their very core.

dance of the silver hurricane.name: Dance of the Silver Hurricane
dance of the silver hurricane.text: Having reached the epitome of the Mithral Current discipline, you know the dance of battle perfectly, and every step you take is attuned to that deadly rhythm.

bronze lancers edge.name: Bronze Lancers Edge
bronze lancers edge.text: With practiced skill, you are capable of achieving greater force with your discipline weapons.

bronze lancet charge.name: Bronze Lancet Charge
bronze lancet charge.text: You make a thunderous charge and deliver a powerful attack.

iron pikemans attitude.name: Iron Pikemans Attitude
iron pikemans attitude.text: You have practiced ways to mitigate and circumvent the woes of heavy armor and gear.

oaken shield.name: Oaken Shield
oaken shield.text: You shift your weapons haft into a more defensible position, shielding you from assault.

phalanx lancer.name: Phalanx Lancer
phalanx lancer.text: Though heavy conditioning and strength training, you have become adept at using a shield in tandem with a polearm to great effect.

piercing strike.name: Piercing Strike
piercing strike.text: You issue a potent impaling blow with your weapon, battering defenses aside and striking bloodily at your foe.

armor-piercing thrust.name: Armor-Piercing Thrust
armor-piercing thrust.text: You make a potent attack toward your foe, unleashing a heavy thrust that pierces through their defenses.

brace for impact.name: Brace for Impact
brace for impact.text: In the chaos of battle, you know you can truly only trust the weapon in your hand.

hastened leap.name: Hastened Leap
hastened leap.text: By using this method, you become capable of a quick burst of speed, launching yourself forward with alacrity towards you foes.

throwing thunder.name: Throwing Thunder
throwing thunder.text: By rearing back for a powerful throw, you are capable of turning any pole arm into a deadly and dangerous missile.

thunderous fall.name: Thunderous Fall
thunderous fall.text: Using the principles of Piercing Thunder, you are well-suited to taking advantage of your superior reach to bring your foes to the ground, be they cavalry or infantry.

goring strike.name: Goring Strike
goring strike.text: With a mighty thrust with your weapon, you pierce your enemies, delivering a devastating attack to multiple foes within your reach.

iron lancers edge.name: Iron Lancers Edge
iron lancers edge.text: You urge punishing force into your attack to devastate your foes.

piercing thunder hammer.name: Piercing Thunder Hammer
