piercing thunder hammer.text: As a seasoned spearman, you know how to leverage your strength properly.

twin thunder stance.name: Twin Thunder Stance
twin thunder stance.text: You have learned how to use normally two-handed weapons in one hand, using the weapons size and momentum to strike your foes with powerful blows.

iron lancet charge.name: Iron Lancet Charge
iron lancet charge.text: Your knowledge of how to deliver a powerful charge that delivers bone-shattering force is unparalleled.

leaping strike.name: Leaping Strike
leaping strike.text: In a daring feat of acrobatics, you leap high into the air and descend with the force of a lightning bolt.

repositioning leap.name: Repositioning Leap
repositioning leap.text: With a powerful leap and roll, you are able to evade an enemys attack and reposition yourself to better defend yourself.

twisting lance.name: Twisting Lance
twisting lance.text: You sweep your enemies legs out from under them with the haft of your weapon before following up with a spinning strike its head.

meteor spiral thrust.name: Meteor Spiral Thrust
meteor spiral thrust.text: You put a vicious twist in your thrust, delivering a powerful blow that penetrates armor and body alike.

stance of the thunderbrand.name: Stance of the Thunderbrand
stance of the thunderbrand.text: You tightly concentrate your focus on the battlefield, maximizing the effectiveness of your reach and keeping enemy attacks at bay.

throwing comet.name: Throwing Comet
throwing comet.text: With an overhand spin, you hurl your polearm at your enemies, decimating their ranks in a whirling path.

twisting parry.name: Twisting Parry
twisting parry.text: A champion of combat, the disciple of the Piercing Thunder is capable of using the size and weight of his weapon to buffet an attack aside to strike at another foe.

diving thunderbolt stance.name: Diving Thunderbolt Stance
diving thunderbolt stance.text: Your movements are light and nimble, allowing you to reach incredible heights and strike with the force of a swooping dragon.

glorious thunder charge.name: Glorious Thunder Charge
glorious thunder charge.text: Brandishing his potent weapon in a glorious display of martial superiority, the disciple charges to battle his foe with determination matched by only the gods themselves.

impaling comet strike.name: Impaling Comet Strike
impaling comet strike.text: You are capable of pressing an incredible assault upon a foe.

lightning rush.name: Lightning Rush
lightning rush.text: By digging in his heels and launching of like a speeding comet, the disciple of the Piercing Thunder is capable of lightning fast sprints for a short period of time.

steel lancers edge.name: Steel Lancers Edge
steel lancers edge.text: You add a burst of speed and force to the end of your charge, striking your foe with a deadly thrust before using the momentum to leap away from their counterattack.

breaking the charge.name: Breaking the Charge
breaking the charge.text: The disciple of the Piercing Thunder is wise to the ways of combat, and when opponents rush by, his lance is always at the ready.

leaping thunder crash.name: Leaping Thunder Crash
leaping thunder crash.text: With a tremendous leap into the air, you come crashing down upon your enemy with the force of the gods themselves.

rush to the fray.name: Rush to the Fray
rush to the fray.text: You charge fearlessly towards a group of foes, heedless of difficulties and deliver a flurry of potent attacks.

adamantine lancers edge.name: Adamantine Lancers Edge
adamantine lancers edge.text: As a master of the Piercing Thunder discipline, you wield your lance with impossible strength and penetrating power, piercing steel as easily as flesh and bone.

deadly thunder lancers stance.name: Deadly Thunder Lancers Stance
deadly thunder lancers stance.text: Mastery of the spear and its many styles comes to you as you near the pinnacle of the Piercing Thunder discipline.

thundering lancers blow.name: Thundering Lancers Blow
thundering lancers blow.text: By leveling a heavy blow from your powerful weapon, you strike so hard to as to bring your opponent to their knees with this strike.

piercing charge of the dread lancer.name: Piercing Charge of the Dread Lancer
piercing charge of the dread lancer.text: As a master of the Piercing Thunder discipline, you can make a devastating charge across the battlefield, striking all in your way with razor precision and unstoppable killing force.

crushing blow.name: Crushing Blow
crushing blow.text: By bringing his weapon high and bringing it down with ferocious finality, the disciples forceful blow is enough to weaken the defenses of his foe momentarily.

panthera on the hunt.name: Panthera on the Hunt
panthera on the hunt.text: With a deep breath and the tightening of honed muscles, the Primal Fury disciple may launch off into a lightning-fast charge.

primal wrath.name: Primal Wrath
primal wrath.text: A wild but powerful strike is better than a frail and accurate one, says the disciple of Primal Fury.

running hunters stance.name: Running Hunters Stance
running hunters stance.text: The swiftest hunter catches the prey, and the Primal Fury disciple has trained his body mercilessly to increase his speed and sharpen his senses.

shoulder rush.name: Shoulder Rush
shoulder rush.text: The disciple of Primal Fury uses his aggression to take opportunities whenever possible, and a solid shoulder into a foe at an opportune moment can tip the scales of war in the disciples favor.

stance of aggression.name: Stance of Aggression
stance of aggression.text: By focusing his fury on the ending of his foes, the disciple forgoes finesse for devastating power.

bloody riposte.name: Bloody Riposte
bloody riposte.text: Stoking the furnace of rage within him upon receiving injury, the disciple uses the momentary lapse in his attackers defenses when struck in combat to make a vicious riposte.

crippling strike.name: Crippling Strike
crippling strike.text: By specifically targeting a victims most vulnerable areas, the disciple is capable of rending arterial injuries into his foe.

devastating rush.name: Devastating Rush
devastating rush.text: The disciple performing this attack executes a powerful attack that rushes in past a foes defenses to shatter them completely.

momentum crash.name: Momentum Crash
momentum crash.text: By putting his fury into a charging attack, the disciple is capable of using the momentum of his charge to increase his killing power with a twist of his body upon connecting.

raging hunter pounce.name: Raging Hunter Pounce
raging hunter pounce.text: With the ferocity of a raging great cat, the disciple of Primal Fury provides the very real fear that users of this discipline are known to inspire with their reckless assault techniques of offense over all.

blade-breaking counter.name: Blade-Breaking Counter
blade-breaking counter.text: An opponent cannot hurt you with his weapon if a weapon does not exist to do it.

disparity blow.name: Disparity Blow
disparity blow.text: With a powerful upswing, the Primal Fury disciple brings his weapon in low and with his attack drives his opponent to the ground as he raises it high to show his superiority.

frenzy strike.name: Frenzy Strike
frenzy strike.text: By emulating the ferocious assault of a raging great cat, the disciples knowledge of the natural world and the way its predators operate assists him in combat with a furious set of attacks.

primal warrior stance.name: Primal Warrior Stance
primal warrior stance.text: By taking a wide stance that invites the death of any before him, the mighty disciple of Primal Fury wields the power of overwhelming force to its greatest effects.

furious primal wrath.name: Furious Primal Wrath
furious primal wrath.text: The disciples attacks grow strong with practiced fury and primal power, forgoing accuracy for pure deadly force.

impaling strike.name: Impaling Strike
impaling strike.text: The disciple who has reached this level of mastery in the art of Primal Fury has learned that by striking to a foes heart and center with a singular but powerful blow, it causes the foes ability to withstand punishment to falter.

momentum crush.name: Momentum Crush
momentum crush.text: With a powerful overhand flourish at the end of his charge, the disciple is capable of delivering additional force to his already devastating charges.

shrug it off.name: Shrug It Off
shrug it off.text: By relying on his instincts to protect him in the theater of war, the disciple twists and dodges to escape injury in the same manner as an animal can sense danger before it strikes.

cornered frenzy strike.name: Cornered Frenzy Strike
cornered frenzy strike.text: As an animal cornered lashes out at all comers, so does the Primal Fury disciple when he finds himself surrounded.

dizzying blow.name: Dizzying Blow
dizzying blow.text: The disciple of the Primal Fury rockets across the battlefield to unleash a powerful strike to the vitals of his foe, leaving him agonized and sick with pain.

lightning step.name: Lightning Step
lightning step.text: Once a great cat has found its prey, the light-footed and graceful cat is capable of nearly ignoring hazards in his path to run it down.

meteoric collision.name: Meteoric Collision
meteoric collision.text: The disciple makes a charge at an opponent within the theater of war with the power and force of a falling meteor, striking hard and bowling his opponent over.

blade of fury.name: Blade of Fury
blade of fury.text: The disciple taps into hidden reserves of fury within himself to pour his all into this strike.

charge of the battle panthera.name: Charge of the Battle Panthera
charge of the battle panthera.text: With a running start that ends in a blood-drenched finish, the disciple mimics the final moments of the hunting great cat as he delivers the death blow to his prey.

shield-breaking strike.name: Shield-Breaking Strike
shield-breaking strike.text: By removing the protection of his prey, the disciple of Primal Fury shreds leather and metal equally as a great cats claws would tear animal hide.

skirmishers stance.name: Skirmishers Stance
skirmishers stance.text: By adopting a hit-and-run attitude, the disciple of Primal Fury disciple moves swiftly and strikes with deadly force.

blood-spray strike.name: Blood-Spray Strike
blood-spray strike.text: The Primal Fury disciple makes a chest-ruining arterial strike on his foe, causing the enemy to suffer grievous amounts of injury.

devastating momentum.name: Devastating Momentum
devastating momentum.text: The charging Primal Fury disciple throws his full weight and momentum behind a blow, showing all who see it who the most powerful combatant on the field of battle truly is.

primal frenzy.name: Primal Frenzy
primal frenzy.text: The disciple becomes a whirling dervish of hellish weapon blows as he descends into a blood-drenched frenzy of strikes against his surrounding foes, relying on his killer instincts to see him through the fight.

iron hide stance.name: Iron Hide Stance
iron hide stance.text: Standing strong in the theater of war, the Primal Fury master stands as a pillar of blood-soaked iron amidst the bodies of those too weak to live in his presence.

meteoric crash.name: Meteoric Crash
meteoric crash.text: By rushing at a foe like a blazing comet through the sky, the Primal Fury disciple crashes through an opponent to sculpt the battlefield into a field of carnage.

unbreakable panthera guard.name: Unbreakable Panthera Guard
unbreakable panthera guard.text: In the flow of battle, a master of the Primal Fury discipline finds nothing more invigorating than a near miss that was avoided through sheer instinct.

wrath of the primal hunter.name: Wrath of the Primal Hunter
wrath of the primal hunter.text: The true master of Primal Fury art is the disciple who brings the full ferocity of this discipline against a foe with a titanic charge that ends with ringing iron and spraying blood as his weapons do their deadly work.

bolster.name: Bolster
bolster.text: You fortify an ally with akasha, hardening their skin like the scales of a dragon.

decree of mercy.name: Decree of Mercy
decree of mercy.text: A simple look and gesture can weaken ones resolve to kill.

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.text: This attack softly removes an enemy from your presence.

the caged sun.name: The Caged Sun
the caged sun.text: If you have 50% or fewer hit points, entering this stance can be done as a free action instead of a swift.

spoils of war.name: Spoils of War
spoils of war.text: Might makes right. While you maintain this stance, allies within close range 25 feet + 5 feet per 2 initiator levels heal 3 hit points whenever they hit with an attack.

staunching strike.name: Staunching Strike
staunching strike.text: To help your allies and harm your enemies is the most basic tenet of the Radiant Dawn discipline.

curate's strike.name: Curate's Strike
curate's strike.text: This strike was created by a kobold leader to fight both controlling magics and vicious wounds.

decree of torment.name: Decree of Torment
decree of torment.text: You strike with an akashic brand that imbalances a creature.

healer's bane.name: Healer's Bane
healer's bane.text: Made to combat other practitioners of the Radiant Dawn discipline, this maneuver hijacks healing for ones own purpose.

expose weakness maneuver.name: Expose Weakness maneuver
expose weakness maneuver.text: You strike with a weak, but swift, attack that hampers an opponent.

witness to glory.name: Witness to Glory
witness to glory.text: With a surge of akasha, you spur an ally into battle.

armaments of the empire.name: Armaments of the Empire
armaments of the empire.text: A thin layer of akasha ows forth from you and covers your and your allies weapons.

decree of death.name: Decree of Death
decree of death.text: You single out a single target for execution.

lifeburst strike.name: Lifeburst Strike
lifeburst strike.text: You strike out with a simple blow with an uncanny power to heal and harm.

disrupt essence.name: Disrupt Essence
disrupt essence.text: A powerful blow that disrupts ones essence, inhibiting the use of abilities.

decree of silence.name: Decree of Silence
decree of silence.text: Your presence demands silence. Only those who you allow to speak may do so.

lifeburst imbuement.name: Lifeburst Imbuement
lifeburst imbuement.text: This maneuver imbues another to carry out your will.

shatter spell.name: Shatter Spell
shatter spell.text: A maneuver whose origins did not come from the disciples of the Radiant Dawn, but was quickly adopted and adapted to deal with spellcasters on the battlefield.

sunstroke.name: Sunstroke
sunstroke.text: Your akasha shapes an attack into a powerful solar flare.

divide and conquer.name: Divide and Conquer
divide and conquer.text: This strike pulls essence from the target, creating an effigy of the creature.

decree of purity.name: Decree of Purity
decree of purity.text: A single word and a wave of the hand purifies those who would stand with you.

noblesse oblige.name: Noblesse Oblige
noblesse oblige.text: When all else fails, your allies turn to you to save them.

stance of the sunlight shield.name: Stance of the Sunlight Shield
stance of the sunlight shield.text: This stance sits halfway between martial form and magic prowess, conjuring shields of light to defend yourself and others.

battle against the sun.name: Battle Against the Sun
battle against the sun.text: To challenge you is to challenge the sun itself: An exercise in futility.

decree of freedom.name: Decree of Freedom
decree of freedom.text: With a gesture and a single word, you cause a targets essence to are, freeing them from their bonds.

king's castle.name: King's Castle
king's castle.text: Your faithful respond to your call for help.

path of the sun.name: Path of the Sun
path of the sun.text: Coalesce the power of the sun into a powerful beam that washes over enemies and allies alike, leaving behind thousands of motes of light.

karmic strike.name: Karmic Strike
karmic strike.text: This blow marks an enemy with a simple brand that burrows into their essence.

awaken the sleeper.name: Awaken the Sleeper
awaken the sleeper.text: Its said that the soul of a mortal contains power that can rival the gods, and this maneuver awakens a fraction of that power for a brief moment.

push the advantage.name: Push the Advantage
push the advantage.text: With the enemy defeated, you spurn an ally towards further glory.

harsh light of day.name: Harsh Light of Day
harsh light of day.text: This attack brings with it a blast of light, forcing enemies to reveal their true selves.

decree of vengeance.name: Decree of Vengeance
decree of vengeance.text: You and your allies rise in revenge against your assailants.

sun's zenith.name: Sun's Zenith
sun's zenith.text: You mimic the eternal dance of the sun across the sky with this stance.

tyrant's end.name: Tyrant's End
tyrant's end.text: This powerful blow brings the end to tyrants reigns.

judgement day.name: Judgement Day
judgement day.text: All enemies within the area are consumed by pure akashic ame, taking 50 points of untyped damage.

clockwatcher.name: Clockwatcher
clockwatcher.text: By pulling your perception forward in time for the barest of moments, you are able to cheat fate and act when most would be caught unaware.

distorted clock.name: Distorted Clock
distorted clock.text: Magic is a fickle thing that wanes in power as the sands glitter through the hourglass of existence.

minute hand.name: Minute Hand
minute hand.text: You make an incredibly swift strike which sacrifices some accuracy for speed.

sands of time stance.name: Sands of Time Stance
sands of time stance.text: By attuning yourself to the ebb and flow of time, you can visualize the time-stream as a metaphorical hourglass in your soul, and learn to manipulate your place within it.

sands of time approach.name: Sands of Time Approach
sands of time approach.text: By wrapping a bit of quintessence around your weapon in the form of a glittering aura, you are capable of striking a foe and burning through the time that he has left.

strike the hourglass.name: Strike the Hourglass
strike the hourglass.text: With a simple strike, you influence times attitude towards a foe and their ability to act in battle.

chronal aggression.name: Chronal Aggression
chronal aggression.text: A Riven Hourglass disciple must end fights quickly, as the sands of time halt for no man.

rapid strike.name: Rapid Strike
rapid strike.text: You compress the time needed to strike twice within the span of a single blow.

stopwatch.name: Stopwatch
stopwatch.text: With a dizzying burst of incredible speed, you step out of time, adjusting your position to possibly avoid an attack.

temporal burn.name: Temporal Burn
temporal burn.text: By surrounding your weapon with a bubble of vastly accelerated time, you are able to strike at a foe and burn away at their personal quintessence.

unhindered step.name: Unhindered Step
unhindered step.text: By slowing the falling sands of the Hourglass inside your soul, you are capable of greatly accelerating your movements.

flickering defense.name: Flickering Defense
flickering defense.text: All actions cause new potential futures, and you can force particularly unlucky futures upon your foes by looking forward and shifting the right sands.

probability twist.name: Probability Twist
probability twist.text: While the flow of time is constantly moving, it is possible for a disciple to analyze and alter how the grains fall within his own Hourglass.

riven hourglass stance.name: Riven Hourglass Stance
riven hourglass stance.text: By altering the flow of time around yourself, you flicker between potential time paths, slipping quietly between the grains that fall within your Hourglass.

temporal fury.name: Temporal Fury
temporal fury.text: You surround your weapon with quintessence, the essence of time that withers all things, and strike at your foe with its burning temporal energies.

time skitter.name: Time Skitter
time skitter.text: By accelerating your personal time-stream, you speed up your movements and accelerate your blows for a few moments.

chronal draw.name: Chronal Draw
chronal draw.text: By damaging the time-flow on a targets vital forces, you temporarily age a foe, exhausting their body before their Hourglass can stabilize.

gift of time.name: Gift of Time
gift of time.text: By focusing and carefully gathering glittering grains of quintessence from within your Hourglass into your hands, you can donate time to another with a touch.

temporal body adjustment.name: Temporal Body Adjustment
temporal body adjustment.text: By reversing the flow of your personal Hourglass, you can turn back time, undoing a harmful event.

tip the hourglass.name: Tip the Hourglass
tip the hourglass.text: By wrapping a field of anarchic temporal energy around your weapon, you strike at your foes own inner Hourglass, seeking to disrupt its flow.

chronal fission.name: Chronal Fission
chronal fission.text: You enter a meditative trance, manipulating your personal time to react faster than you otherwise would be able to.

hour hand.name: Hour Hand
hour hand.text: You compress the timeframe of your attack, sacrificing precision to make a lightning-fast strike.

sands of time tornado.name: Sands of Time Tornado
sands of time tornado.text: You accelerate your personal Hourglass, speeding up your mind and body to the point that you seem to be a blur, surrounded by a phantom aura of glittering smoke.

time-thiefs talons.name: Time-Thiefs Talons
time-thiefs talons.text: Every being holds within its Hourglass sands of time that mark how long they will reside in this world, and you have learned to steal anothers grains to replenish your own.

relativity burst.name: Relativity Burst
relativity burst.text: By rearranging how your time is managed, you can manipulate the present, shifting your position on the battlefield.

sand-bearers swiftness.name: Sand-Bearers Swiftness
sand-bearers swiftness.text: You open a floodgate within your soul, channeling time-accelerating energies through your body to move at blindingly-fast speeds.

shatter the hourglass.name: Shatter the Hourglass
shatter the hourglass.text: With a heavy blow, you strike your foes Hourglass directly, temporarily shattering it and freezing their timeline in place.

temporal distortion.name: Temporal Distortion
temporal distortion.text: By finding yourself in an immediate need of action, you are capable of stretching a tiny amount of time into the moments needed to move yourself away from danger.

temporal wave.name: Temporal Wave
temporal wave.text: You reach deep within your soul and pull forth a handful of quintessence to cast at your foes, wreaking havoc upon their ability to act.

beat the clock.name: Beat the Clock
beat the clock.text: You briefly accelerate your personal timeframe, acting so fast that you appear to be a blur.

sands of time hurricane.name: Sands of Time Hurricane
sands of time hurricane.text: By pouring time-accelerating energies through your form, your perception of time grinds to a halt, allowing you to erupt into a whirlwind of perfect strikes and glittering quintessence at supernatural speed.

temporal dilation.name: Temporal Dilation
temporal dilation.text: By summoning up a time-altering aura into your hand and channeling it through a foe, you can destabilize their Hourglass, pushing them out of sync with the present for a few scant moments.

god of the hourglass stance.name: God of the Hourglass Stance
god of the hourglass stance.text: Your control over your own time-stuff allows you to isolate your Hourglass from reality, causing you to move with unparalleled speed and grace and affording you protection from those who would manipulate your quintessence.

heart of the time lord.name: Heart of the Time Lord
heart of the time lord.text: When the sands within your Hourglass finally run dry, you can force your timeline to restart, willing the sands to reverse within your soul and restore what has been lost.

wrath of time.name: Wrath of Time
wrath of time.text: You open your Hourglass and those of all around you, willing their grains to scatter in an attempt to outright erase their futures.

break the hourglass.name: Break the Hourglass
break the hourglass.text: By forcing your will upon the quintessence of the universe and acting within pockets of time so small that blink past within the gap between seconds, you turn time on its end and react to an opponents actions before they have even been made

crouching lion.name: Crouching Lion
crouching lion.text: You move with a strange grace, befuddling your enemies.

give me a hand.name: Give Me a Hand
give me a hand.text: You know how to gang up on your enemies, using your allies to your advantage.

over and under.name: Over and Under
over and under.text: You use your trickery to your advantage, either striking a foe in a vulnerable spot or knocking them down.

rat pack.name: Rat Pack
rat pack.text: Your allies can help you with complex tactics, even if they dont really know what theyre doing.

squeak by.name: Squeak By
squeak by.text: Your agility offers you unique opportunities when countering attacks.

tricksy strike.name: Tricksy Strike
tricksy strike.text: Your strike gives your foe a false sense of superiority, setting them up for exploitation.

distraction strike.name: Distraction Strike
distraction strike.text: Your antics give your allies a juicy target.

nimble mouse.name: Nimble Mouse
nimble mouse.text: Armor means nothing, if you know the weak points.

rat takes the cheese.name: Rat Takes the Cheese
rat takes the cheese.text: Your opponent wasnt using that anyways. Upon initiating this boost, make a steal or disarm attempt, using an Escape Artist check in place of the normal CMB roll against the target's CMD.

rat trap.name: Rat Trap
rat trap.text: You got your tail caught, but you make the most of it.

toe-stepping strike.name: Toe-Stepping Strike
toe-stepping strike.text: Youre always in the way, right where your foes wish you werent.

cat takes the rat.name: Cat Takes the Rat
cat takes the rat.text: Its not nice to play with your food, but that never stopped you.

pussyfoot stance.name: Pussyfoot Stance
pussyfoot stance.text: You are always just out of sight, striking where your foes least expect it.

two for one.name: Two for One
two for one.text: Youre so generous, you give you foes plenty of attention.

underhanded strike.name: Underhanded Strike
underhanded strike.text: Fair fights are for suckers. Make a melee attack.

all according to plan.name: All According to Plan
all according to plan.text: You set up a brilliant plan for your allies to execute.

cornered rat.name: Cornered Rat
cornered rat.text: You show your true ferocity when backed into a corner.

just go with it.name: Just Go With It
just go with it.text: Your allies are used to your schemes, and roll with whatever you come up with.

rat race.name: Rat Race
rat race.text: Sometimes you just need to know when to bail.

chew through.name: Chew Through
chew through.text: A snip here, a cut there, and soon your opponents defenses are in shambles.

rat in a cage.name: Rat in a Cage
rat in a cage.text: You show your foes just what its like being helpless and alone.

rat takes the cat.name: Rat Takes the Cat
rat takes the cat.text: With a simple technique, you flip the world upside down.

swarming stance.name: Swarming Stance
swarming stance.text: You have absolutely no regard for personal space, especially your foes.

bell the cat.name: Bell the Cat
bell the cat.text: Who will bell the cat? You, thats who. Make an attack.

clever cat stance.name: Clever Cat Stance
clever cat stance.text: Your movements set your foes on edge, distracting them and preventing them from using their abilities to the fullest.

dormouse strike.name: Dormouse Strike
dormouse strike.text: You send your foe into a deep sleep with this precision strike.

scatter.name: Scatter
scatter.text: With a wink and a nod, your allies activate a secret formation.

magnificent bastard.name: Magnificent Bastard
magnificent bastard.text: You magnificent bastard, you read them like a book!

sick trick.name: Sick Trick
sick trick.text: You hit em where it hurts, keeping your foes gasping in pain.

undermine.name: Undermine
undermine.text: Invulnerable is just another kind of vulnerable.

stance of the elder rat.name: Stance of the Elder Rat
stance of the elder rat.text: Your tactics are transcendental. As long as you maintain this stance, all of your allies within 60 feet are granted your Teamwork feats.

the old switcheroo.name: The Old Switcheroo
the old switcheroo.text: The oldest trick in the book, and they fell for it.

the worlds greatest trick.name: The Worlds Greatest Trick
the worlds greatest trick.text: This is it, it doesnt get any better than this.

herding cats.name: Herding Cats
herding cats.text: You have reached the pinnacle of mastery for the Roaring Mouse.

asteroid belt.name: Asteroid Belt
asteroid belt.text: Attuning yourself to the cosmos, you emulate a special gravitational field around your body that lets your possessions orbit around you.

blazing comet trail.name: Blazing Comet Trail
blazing comet trail.text: Imbued with the light of the heavens, your arrow sears a path across the battlefield where it flew.

celestial warning.name: Celestial Warning
celestial warning.text: As a warden of the night sky, you fire an arrow destined to strike those who stray onto the wrong path.

milky way trail.name: Milky Way Trail
milky way trail.text: Your attack leaves a shimmering trail of light behind it, subtly affecting gravity to influence movements.

slivers of a shattered star.name: Slivers of a Shattered Star
slivers of a shattered star.text: Your projectiles carry the explosive energy of a destroyed star within them - but it manifests as fate rather than force.

uncertain omen.name: Uncertain Omen
uncertain omen.text: A near miss from your arrow fills enemies with esoteric, jumbled visions of the future that steer them off course.

aligned with prediction.name: Aligned with Prediction
aligned with prediction.text: You have pondered keenly on the movements of the stars, and the metaphors they hold for the myriad futures: there is little that you havent anticipated.

astral displacement.name: Astral Displacement
astral displacement.text: Your insight of the heavens tells you how to be where you need to be, and how to not be where you shouldnt.

bad moon rising.name: Bad Moon Rising
bad moon rising.text: You rise into prime position, like the appearance of the moon from beneath the horizon.

black cat's trail.name: Black Cat's Trail
black cat's trail.text: Your attack traces a path of tragedy and misfortune that curses those who cross it, who can then either fulfill the curse on their own terms or suffer the consequences.

vacuum imbuement trail.name: Vacuum Imbuement Trail
vacuum imbuement trail.text: Your attack creates a trail that imbues enemies bodies and armor with the vast emptiness of the cosmos, turning them translucent and weakening their physical defenses.

celestial hurricane stance.name: Celestial Hurricane Stance
celestial hurricane stance.text: The stars in the night sky number thousands and thousands; a scale that your hail of arrows can only hope to emulate.

equinox.name: Equinox
equinox.text: Trusting fate and fortune to guide your arrow, you launch it into the sky to fall at the perfect moment.

heaven's binding trail.name: Heaven's Binding Trail
heaven's binding trail.text: Your attack leaves a translucent trail of dusty streams behind it, which threaten to solidify and bind those who cross them.

micromassive black hole.name: Micromassive Black Hole
micromassive black hole.text: You will gravity to condense for a moment, pulling all mass towards it.

aeon rift trail.name: Aeon Rift Trail
aeon rift trail.text: Your attack distorts the fabric of spacetime in its wake.

asteroid salvo.name: Asteroid Salvo
asteroid salvo.text: With a flourish, you produce and fire a barrage of swerving energy missiles that seek out enemies and detonate violently.

lucent flashback.name: Lucent Flashback
lucent flashback.text: You gather a mote of volatile star-energy in your hand and fling it into the fray where it bursts in a concentrated wave of light, vibrations and radiation.

music of the spheres.name: Music of the Spheres
music of the spheres.text: Your attack empowers your allies with cosmic alacrity.

celestrial orrery stance.name: Celestrial Orrery Stance
celestrial orrery stance.text: You channel visions of the entire cosmos through yourself, projecting the stars around you.

dual eclipse trail.name: Dual Eclipse Trail
dual eclipse trail.text: Your attack blurs the boundaries of seen and unseen by manipulating both light and shadow.

gravity well.name: Gravity Well
gravity well.text: You fire a sudden shot that drastically increases the targets gravity towards selective objects.

localized wormhole trail.name: Localized Wormhole Trail
localized wormhole trail.text: Your attack reweaves physical space. Make a 90 ft.

prophecy of destruction.name: Prophecy of Destruction
prophecy of destruction.text: With a word of doom and a gesture, you take aim at a specific point of the battlefield and foretell havoc upon it.

aurora fortress trail.name: Aurora Fortress Trail
aurora fortress trail.text: Your attack leaves a translucent rainbow trail of light behind that holds back the enemy.

reading the tapestry of fate.name: Reading the Tapestry of Fate
reading the tapestry of fate.text: You see through the fortune of an enemy and divine their fate.

stance of infinite prophecies.name: Stance of Infinite Prophecies
stance of infinite prophecies.text: By briefly committing to dozens of attack plans and then receiving scattered future visions of their outcomes, you can assess a creatures defenses before you even act.

when the stars align.name: When the Stars Align
when the stars align.text: You fire a shot into the sky as you whisper a prophecy, beckoning it to strike true when it is fulfilled.

fate's rail gun.name: Fate's Rail Gun
fate's rail gun.text: Every journey on the rail of fate has an end.

heaven's fury.name: Heaven's Fury
heaven's fury.text: You fire a flurry of ranged attacks into the sky, and they rain down with a vengeance upon the battlefield like meteors.

omniscience trace.name: Omniscience Trace
omniscience trace.text: There is nowhere in the universe, or even the multiverse, that is outside the range of your marksmanship.

a blink of the universe.name: A Blink of the Universe
a blink of the universe.text: Imbued in your strike is the immutable fate of the universe, the ordinant song by which the greatest stars in the cosmos live and one day die.

embodiment of the first meteor.name: Embodiment of the first Meteor
embodiment of the first meteor.text: You are set ablaze with pure white light, and small shockwaves constantly emanate from you.

threading the tapestry of fate.name: Threading the Tapestry of Fate
threading the tapestry of fate.text: Striking an enemy at the meridian of their cosmic alignment, you rewrite their entire immediate destiny.

timeless army across heaven.name: Timeless Army Across Heaven
timeless army across heaven.text: You understand the most innate divine might of the cosmos, and for a tiny fraction of eternity you can call on its aid.

blade of breaking.name: Blade of Breaking
blade of breaking.text: A Scarlet Throne disciple knows that sometimes to defeat the beast, you must remove its claws.

circular stance.name: Circular Stance
circular stance.text: Practitioners of Scarlet Throne know that to be a lord amongst warriors, he must walk the path of battle alone, and he understands that often times he may be beset by all sides.

princes attitude.name: Princes Attitude
princes attitude.text: The Scarlet Throne disciple knows that he is nobility in the savagery of war, and conducts himself as such when moving through melee.

red zephyrs strike.name: Red Zephyrs Strike
red zephyrs strike.text: With swiftness born of skill, a disciple of the Scarlet Throne learns how to move through the battlefield as lord among warriors.

scarlet einhander.name: Scarlet Einhander
scarlet einhander.text: By adopting this stance, the disciple presents a slim profile to his foes, holding his weapon low and one-handed, and leads with his blade in an elegant and graceful manner, his strikes strong and his profile aiding him in defense.

scything strike.name: Scything Strike
scything strike.text: The principles of the Scarlet Throne teach its disciples that every swing must be made with precision and excellence; no movement is wasted and no attack should be fruitless.

garnet lance.name: Garnet Lance
garnet lance.text: With a sudden and powerful thrust, the disciple penetrates the defenses of his foe with devastating alacrity.

regal blade.name: Regal Blade
regal blade.text: A disciple of the Scarlet Throne learns that in moments of precise focus, a single stroke of the blade can fell a potent enemy.

rising zenith strike.name: Rising Zenith Strike
rising zenith strike.text: With supreme focus, comes great insight into the workings of a foes defenses.

sanguine barrier.name: Sanguine Barrier
sanguine barrier.text: The focus required in battle allows the disciple to anticipate incoming attacks.

dazing attack.name: Dazing Attack
dazing attack.text: The swiftness of the Scarlet Throne disciples blade is a thing of terrific power, and by initiating this strike he demonstrates this potency.

scarlet eyes perception.name: Scarlet Eyes Perception
scarlet eyes perception.text: By watching his opponents defenses and waiting for the hole in them to open, the Scarlet Throne disciple strikes with the speed of the gods.

strike of defeat.name: Strike of Defeat
strike of defeat.text: A dead foe is a foe that can trouble you no more, is an old adage of the Scarlet Throne disciple.

unfettered movement.name: Unfettered Movement
unfettered movement.text: The Scarlet Throne disciple is swift in battle and in his ability to go from one skirmish to the next to choose his next foe.

noble blade.name: Noble Blade
noble blade.text: Scarlet Throne practitioners who know the Noble Blade may use their battle focus to add additional force to their strikes.

red zephyrs dance.name: Red Zephyrs Dance
red zephyrs dance.text: The Red Zephyrs Dance allows the disciple to step confidently through a battlefield, his blade leading the way in decisive sweeps as a graceful as a ballroom dance.

sanguine perseverance.name: Sanguine Perseverance
sanguine perseverance.text: The focus of battle that a disciple of Scarlet Throne has allows him to react to danger before he actively knows it is present, his senses acknowledging peril before his mind would know of it.

weeping scarlet razor.name: Weeping Scarlet Razor
weeping scarlet razor.text: Even the basest common soldier knows that there are places on a mans body where if he were to be stabbed, then he would bleed out in minutes.

riddle of iron.name: Riddle of Iron
riddle of iron.text: With a flourishing of his blade, the Scarlet Throne disciple confuses the senses of his foe as he lands a strike from an unexpected angle.

ruby zenith strike.name: Ruby Zenith Strike
ruby zenith strike.text: The focus of battle teaches that in a single hairs breadth of time, a warrior may strike down a foe in a single blow.

sanguine perfection.name: Sanguine Perfection
sanguine perfection.text: The supreme clarity of mind and focus of form allows a disciple of Scarlet Throne to simply overcome any obstacle placed before him, albeit for the short term.

scarlet riposte.name: Scarlet Riposte
scarlet riposte.text: Within the focus of the disciples mind, pathways to victory form which he uses to sculpt and mold the outcome of the battle.

blade of perfection.name: Blade of Perfection
blade of perfection.text: In an instant of perfect clarity, the disciple finds his moment to strike true.

final blow.name: Final Blow
final blow.text: Mercy has a place on the battlefield, a disciple of Scarlet Throne understands, as does the benefit of an honorable and swift death.

red zephyrs fleetness.name: Red Zephyrs Fleetness
red zephyrs fleetness.text: The combat focus of a Scarlet Throne disciple lends itself to the analogy of the coiled spring; when necessary, the spring can rapidly unfold and launch with incredible celerity.

scarlet duelist attitude.name: Scarlet Duelist Attitude
scarlet duelist attitude.text: The force of will that a disciple of Scarlet Throne possesses is enough to protect him and guide his steps through battle, and his battle focus allows him to anticipate danger before it happens.

royal blade.name: Royal Blade
royal blade.text: As a true king of battle, the disciple brings his mastery of Scarlet Throne to the battlefield to the despair of his foes.

ruby battle lords strike.name: Ruby Battle Lords Strike
ruby battle lords strike.text: Perfection in combat is the true goal of any disciple of Scarlet Throne, and to become a true master of this discipline is to know how to strike perfectly with each and every attack.

sanguine proclamation.name: Sanguine Proclamation
sanguine proclamation.text: With a mighty overhand swing the Scarlet Throne disciple puts his foe in their place; on their knees before the majesty of a prince of warriors.

descending sunset strike.name: Descending Sunset Strike
descending sunset strike.text: With a downward swing of his blade, the Scarlet Throne adapt proves his mastery of the discipline by shattering the will of the enemy to fight.

riddle of steel.name: Riddle of Steel
riddle of steel.text: With a swift and deadly strike, the disciple is capable of disabling a foes senses for a few moments, effectively eliminating the threat.

scarlet majesty stance.name: Scarlet Majesty Stance
scarlet majesty stance.text: The fearsome glory of a master disciple of the Scarlet Throne discipline causes him to appear as nothing less than a god of war incarnated in flesh and steel.

heavenly blade of the scarlet throne.name: Heavenly Blade of the Scarlet Throne
heavenly blade of the scarlet throne.text: The supreme technique of the Scarlet Throne, the disciple who knows of it is the lord of all battlefields and marks his name amongst the legends of war.

breaking glass strike.name: Breaking Glass Strike
breaking glass strike.text: Your vicious strike flares with shards of mirror-bright color that dazzle and dizzy your victim.

copycat cut.name: Copycat Cut
copycat cut.text: With a slight shift of your stance, you mimic an attack youve witnessed in the last few seconds of combat.

doppelganger dance.name: Doppelganger Dance
doppelganger dance.text: With supernatural alacrity, you mimic your foes movements, preventing them from escaping you.

funhouse waltz.name: Funhouse Waltz
funhouse waltz.text: With a moments concentration, you shift your movements, advancing like a warped reflection.

left-hand strike.name: Left-Hand Strike
left-hand strike.text: A minor twist of reality makes it seem like your strike is two places at once.

obsidian reflection stance.name: Obsidian Reflection Stance
obsidian reflection stance.text: You emanate an aura that either enhances the perceptions of those within it or makes them warped and twisted.

broken mirror strike.name: Broken Mirror Strike
broken mirror strike.text: With a mirror-bright slash, you put jagged cracks in your opponents defenses.

equivocate.name: Equivocate
equivocate.text: You ensnare yourself and a foe in a reflective relationship.

mimics gambit.name: Mimics Gambit
mimics gambit.text: Drawing on your power over reflections and mimicry, you copy an effect from your victim.

obsidian razor style.name: Obsidian Razor Style
obsidian razor style.text: Like obsidian, you create a reflection that is beautiful, dark, and deadly at the edge of your weapon.

obsidian sidestep.name: Obsidian Sidestep
obsidian sidestep.text: With an act of will, you distort reality to avoid harm.

curse of the twisted reflection.name: Curse of the Twisted Reflection
curse of the twisted reflection.text: With a hideous strike, you distort the perceptions of your enemies.

infinity mirror stance.name: Infinity Mirror Stance
infinity mirror stance.text: By bending the light near yourself, you create a deceptive defense against assault.

reflected blade style.name: Reflected Blade Style
reflected blade style.text: Your will creates a glimmering mirror of your assaults, afflicting two enemies at once.

shattered glass smite.name: Shattered Glass Smite
shattered glass smite.text: With your will and your weapon, you shatter reality as you would shatter a mirror, shredding your enemies with false glass.

blazing mirror strike.name: Blazing Mirror Strike
blazing mirror strike.text: In a flash of bright death, your weapon transforms into light, passing through your foes armor and scorching their eyes.

carnival swap.name: Carnival Swap
carnival swap.text: You catch your enemy in the reflection of your blade and twist reality like a funhouse mirror, leaving an unfair trade.

doppleganger waltz.name: Doppleganger Waltz
doppleganger waltz.text: Like a reflection in the mirror, you follow your enemies every move.

fetchs wrath.name: Fetchs Wrath
fetchs wrath.text: Like an unquiet spirit, you travel through light and reflections, striking down those foolish enough to tempt your wrath.

curse of the smoking mirror.name: Curse of the Smoking Mirror
curse of the smoking mirror.text: With an obsidian-edged blow, you reflect an enemys malice back onto itself, tainting them from within.

empty frame.name: Empty Frame
empty frame.text: With an effort of will you shed substance but not form.

gleaming imprisonment.name: Gleaming Imprisonment
gleaming imprisonment.text: Twisting the reflections around your blade, you mark an enemy with it and imprison them in of mirrors.

silvered mirror stance.name: Silvered Mirror Stance
silvered mirror stance.text: Like a prism or a silver mirror, you splash joy and light onto those whom you love.

copycats cunning.name: Copycats Cunning
copycats cunning.text: opponent within range Your supernatural mimicry permits you to ape the tools used by your friends and foes.

cursed mirror stance.name: Cursed Mirror Stance
cursed mirror stance.text: You mimic your opponents movements, visiting retribution upon them.

murderous reflection.name: Murderous Reflection
murderous reflection.text: Like something out of a nightmare you turn an opponents strength against them.

plagiarism.name: Plagiarism
plagiarism.text: You copy an opponents technique, stripping it from them in the process.

warped glass strike.name: Warped Glass Strike
warped glass strike.text: You re-write the perceptions of your victim with a blow, turning friend and enemy alike into horrific nightmares that can only be opposed.

double team.name: Double Team
double team.text: You create a semi-real copy of yourself to attack an opponent, striking them high and low.

infinite reflections.name: Infinite Reflections
infinite reflections.text: As your blade connects, you seem to vanish, before reappearing around your opponent several times in succession and delivering blow after blow.

mirror demons waltz.name: Mirror Demons Waltz
mirror demons waltz.text: You step through reflected light, vanishing into the splash of light of of a blade and emerging from a mirror, a prism, or even the reflection in an enemys eye.

obsidian negation.name: Obsidian Negation
obsidian negation.text: You conjure a shard of black glass, imprisoning not only your enemys power but the very concept of the tool he attempts to use.

shattered mirror strike.name: Shattered Mirror Strike
shattered mirror strike.text: With a casual blow, you annihilate your opponents perceptions, writing and rewriting their senses until they can only perceive reality as a shattered ruin.

unholy mirror stance.name: Unholy Mirror Stance
unholy mirror stance.text: Woe and discord are multiplied by your reflective power.

septennial seal.name: Septennial Seal
septennial seal.text: The ultimate expression of your reflective power creates a mirror behind your victim just before you strike them with your magic-laced blade, blowing their soul out of their body and into your trap.

crane step.name: Crane Step
crane step.text: The grace of the Silver Crane blesses the initiator with the ability to step through battle unhindered and unharmed.

enduring crane strike.name: Enduring Crane Strike
enduring crane strike.text: Making his soul a wellspring of holy power, the disciple strikes out at a foe to unleashed his holy power to restore health to himself or an ally.

eyes of the crane.name: Eyes of the Crane
eyes of the crane.text: Using the perception of the disciples heavenly training to assist him, the Silver Crane practitioner may see many things which would remain hidden from the eyes of the impure.

flashing wings.name: Flashing Wings
flashing wings.text: The flashing wings of the Silver Crane daze the foes of the martial disciple, burning their eyes with the light of Heaven.

silver crane waltz.name: Silver Crane Waltz
silver crane waltz.text: The divine vantage point of the celestial realms infuses the mind of the disciple, granting him momentary flickers of foresight.

silver strike.name: Silver Strike
silver strike.text: Using the insight of the Heavens, the martial disciple learns to read the tangles of fate to direct their efforts in battle.

blazing cranes wing.name: Blazing Cranes Wing
blazing cranes wing.text: By filling the Silver Crane disciples weapon with the strength of his celestial patrons, the warrior funnels their righteous wrath against those that are abominations in the eyes of all that is good.

blessed pinions.name: Blessed Pinions
blessed pinions.text: The pinion feathers of the Silver Cranes wings gain an ethereal glimmer as if they were blessed steel.

defensive step.name: Defensive Step
defensive step.text: Inspired by the awareness of the celestial realm, the discipline trusts in his heavenly sense of the battle around him to see where the next attack is coming and move away from danger.

emerald displacement strike.name: Emerald Displacement Strike
emerald displacement strike.text: Sight is imperative in arts of the hunting bird, and a warrior learns that this holds true for his enemy.

exorcism strike.name: Exorcism Strike
exorcism strike.text: The foes of the celestial realms tremble in fear at the wrath of the Heavens themselves, and a disciple of the Silver Crane wields that righteous anger in battle.

silver cranes blessing.name: Silver Cranes Blessing
silver cranes blessing.text: By invoking the powers of his celestial patrons upon successfully smiting an enemy of the heavens, the holy power of the Silver Crane disciples patron flows through him to restore the health of the vessel or the ally of the vessel.

silver knights blade.name: Silver Knights Blade
silver knights blade.text: Those graced with the blessings of the Silver Crane are both terrors to their foes and heroes to their fellows.

stance of the silver crane.name: Stance of the Silver Crane
stance of the silver crane.text: The martial disciple with knowledge of this stance learns to channel the potency of their celestial patrons to combat evil with great efficiency.

sacred pinions.name: Sacred Pinions
sacred pinions.text: The martial disciple enhances his melee strikes with the blessed wings of the Silver Crane, infusing them with celestial might to strike beyond flesh and bite spirit.

sapphire displacement strike.name: Sapphire Displacement Strike
sapphire displacement strike.text: The agents of the celestial realms guide your blade and hinder the senses of your foes.

silver crane resurgence.name: Silver Crane Resurgence
silver crane resurgence.text: By invoking the power of his celestial patron, the Silver Crane disciple may overcome the fell powers and curses of his enemies and return to full fighting ability.

silver cranes leap.name: Silver Cranes Leap
silver cranes leap.text: The flow of battle runs sharply through the Silver Crane disciples mind, allowing him to see where his opponents will move before he makes his own.

argent knights banner.name: Argent Knights Banner
argent knights banner.text: Infusing his arms and weapon with the glory of the Silver Cranes majesty, the martial disciple smites his foe and radiates a banner of heavenly wings, which explode with celestial light and power.

emerald-tipped feathers.name: Emerald-Tipped Feathers
emerald-tipped feathers.text: A defensive technique of the Silver Crane calls for the hardening of the channeled celestials essence around the disciple to protect him from harm.

silver cranes spiral.name: Silver Cranes Spiral
silver cranes spiral.text: Filling himself with the wrath of the heavens, the Silver Crane disciple takes on a nimbus of glowing wings and lashes out at all of his nearby enemies with smiting strikes.

stance of the crane knight.name: Stance of the Crane Knight
stance of the crane knight.text: As a disciple of the Silver Crane, the martial disciple may manifest the essence of his celestial patrons along his body, its light radiating from his soul to form silver-feathered ethereal wings from his back and a blazing halo of argent r

argent kings scepter.name: Argent Kings Scepter
argent kings scepter.text: The initiator of this strike holds his weapon aloft briefly, allowing it to fill with holy wrath before striking the blazing weapon down with righteous finality.

holy pinions.name: Holy Pinions
holy pinions.text: Using this advanced technique of the Silver Crane, the martial disciple infuses his strike with the pure celestial essence of their heavenly companion and smites the forces of the Lower Planes.

silver crane endurance.name: Silver Crane Endurance
silver crane endurance.text: By reciting a litany of praises and prayers to the glory of the angels and to the heavens above, the Silver Crane disciple is filled with restorative power from his patrons.

silver cranes mercy.name: Silver Cranes Mercy
silver cranes mercy.text: With a recitation of power and a prayer for mercy upon those who are servants of heaven, the Silver Crane disciple strikes out at the evil he battles.

diamond displacement strike.name: Diamond Displacement Strike
diamond displacement strike.text: A blinded warrior cannot strike with his eyes, and most cannot strike with their mind.

diamond-tipped feathers.name: Diamond-Tipped Feathers
diamond-tipped feathers.text: The ultimate defensive technique of the Silver Crane, glittering wings of celestial might wrap around the martial disciple initiating this maneuver, protecting him from harm.

holy rush.name: Holy Rush
holy rush.text: With a rush of speed and flare of arching wings of light, the martial disciple speeds towards an ally within the blink of an eye.

benediction of the silver crane.name: Benediction of the Silver Crane
benediction of the silver crane.text: With a powerful cry of need, the true glory of heavens mercy pours down upon the Silver Crane disciple in a flood of healing benediction.

celestial pinions.name: Celestial Pinions
celestial pinions.text: Martial disciples with this technique have learned to strike through the ether and destroy the very essence of their infernal foes in a blazing torrent of holy light.

diamond wings of the imperial crane.name: Diamond Wings of the Imperial Crane
diamond wings of the imperial crane.text: The true master of the Silver Crane discipline who learns its mysteries must be prepared to take the fight to the enemies of the Upper Planes.

strike of silver exorcism.name: Strike of Silver Exorcism
strike of silver exorcism.text: The ultimate technique of the Silver Crane is a strike that rends the essence of the foes of the heavens asunder and brings them to ruin in one blazing stroke.

battle mantra.name: Battle Mantra
battle mantra.text: In the heat of battle, every second matters and every blow is crucial.

body of delusion.name: Body of Delusion
body of delusion.text: The most basic tenet of the Sleeping Goddess discipline is that a strong enough belief, channeled through the lens of psionic power, can do anything.

call the souls blade.name: Call the Souls Blade
call the souls blade.text: As an adept of the Sleeping Goddess discipline, your greatest weapon is your personal ideology given form.

ego-wounding strike.name: Ego-Wounding Strike
ego-wounding strike.text: You wrap your blade in psionic energy, telepathically amplifying the pain of the blow.

flash of insight.name: Flash of Insight
flash of insight.text: You turn a sudden burst of inspiration into strength for your allies, sharing your power to give them an edge in battle and help them shrug of their wounds.

harmony-shattering strike.name: Harmony-Shattering Strike
harmony-shattering strike.text: You strike at both your enemys body and his spirit, creating a destructive link between them and your allies.

unbroken stride.name: Unbroken Stride
unbroken stride.text: With careful steps and focused psionic power, you can slightly shift how you interact with the world, moving over liquids as if they were solid, sprinting along walls, and even walking through the air.

adamant will.name: Adamant Will
adamant will.text: Though armor can be pierced and shields can be broken, your will remains a final bastion, and those who witness this resolution of mind can be inspired to cultivate it within themselves.

fearless faith.name: Fearless Faith
fearless faith.text: You know that fear is as great an enemy as the foes in front of you, and through this knowledge and your faith in yourself, you can power through even the most terrifying situations.

mind-revealing strike.name: Mind-Revealing Strike
mind-revealing strike.text: You and your allies harry a foe, weakening its resolve and leaving it open to mental intrusion.

reactive reversion.name: Reactive Reversion
reactive reversion.text: You create a spiritual waypoint tied to your mind and body, allowing you to return to it in an instant for a short time.

twofold assault.name: Twofold Assault
twofold assault.text: You assault your opponents mind and body at the same instant, overwhelming them utterly with a single blow.

chains of doubt.name: Chains of Doubt
chains of doubt.text: You deliver a psionically-charged blow directly to your enemys willpower and ability to press onwards, dragging them down with crushing doubt and despair.

grasp of the goddess.name: Grasp of the Goddess
grasp of the goddess.text: For a brief moment, you transcend the limits of your physical form, striking beyond the reach of your weapons and reacting with a speed and grace you would not normally have.

inexorable embrace of sleep.name: Inexorable Embrace of Sleep
inexorable embrace of sleep.text: With a devastating psychic strike, you can render a foes higher mind catatonic, reducing him to the state of a sleepwalker.

internal dominion of the sleeping goddes.name: Internal Dominion of the Sleeping Goddess
internal dominion of the sleeping goddes.text: The term sleeping goddess refers not to any tangible entity, but a state of being; by focusing your psionic might through the lens of true belief, you become something akin to a minor divine power whose realm lies within your physical form.

armory of the sleeping goddess.name: Armory of the Sleeping Goddess
armory of the sleeping goddess.text: Your immense force of will allows you to shape your ideals into a more powerful weapon than before.

puppet of the goddess.name: Puppet of the Goddess
puppet of the goddess.text: You take control of your foes perceptions, shutting them of from reality and substituting a false world of your choosing.

reunion in dreams.name: Reunion in Dreams
reunion in dreams.text: Your understanding of the world and your place in it grows, and allows you to reach out to others and bring them under your protection even over great distances.

traumatic reversal.name: Traumatic Reversal
traumatic reversal.text: Just as a warrior with a superior weapon may try to sunder an attackers blade, you are able to shatter your foes mind in order to defend yourself, creating a momentary psionic link along which the effects of their attack are shared.

inarguable presence of the sleeping godd.name: Inarguable Presence of the Sleeping Goddess
inarguable presence of the sleeping godd.text: Your psionic might and the strength of your belief exert an immense pressure on the minds of your foes merely by being near them.

reshape the sculpted mind.name: Reshape the Sculpted Mind
reshape the sculpted mind.text: Your intimate acquaintance with the nature of the mind allows you to strike it where its most vulnerable.

reverberation of defeat.name: Reverberation of Defeat
reverberation of defeat.text: As you destroy one foe, his allies feel the weight of his failure, the pain, fear, and feeling of utter defeat cascading down the ties of friendship or belief.

the ties that bind.name: The Ties that Bind
the ties that bind.text: With a psionically-empowered strike, you stab through an enemys physical form and attack their spirit and those tied to it.

convert intrusion.name: Convert Intrusion
convert intrusion.text: With a practiced flourish of your weapon and a surge of spiritual might, you tear magic asunder and redirect its power to assist your allies.

dreaming nomad strike.name: Dreaming Nomad Strike
dreaming nomad strike.text: You force reality around you to become dreamlike, eschewing the restrictions of distance and becoming a whirlwind of strikes flowing across the battlefield without needing to take a single step.

overpowering optimism.name: Overpowering Optimism
overpowering optimism.text: Your faith in yourself allows you to press the advantage further than mostby believing you can succeed, you change yourself into someone who will.

strike of transfixed awe.name: Strike of Transfixed Awe
strike of transfixed awe.text: Your strike momentarily alters the flow of magic around your opponent, viciously rending power from their mind.

unavoidable gaze of the sleeping goddess.name: Unavoidable Gaze of the Sleeping Goddess
unavoidable gaze of the sleeping goddess.text: You open your senses, gaining perfect awareness of the world around you with your enhanced perception.

perfect distillation of the soul.name: Perfect Distillation of the Soul
perfect distillation of the soul.text: Your souls blade is unparalleled in form, shining as a beacon of your will and ideals, and carving through your foes as well as even the most powerful magic weapons.

pierce the soul.name: Pierce the Soul
pierce the soul.text: You deliver a deadly blow to an enemy with a familiar or similar bond, striking through the mystic ties between master and servant.

soul-crushing mien.name: Soul-Crushing Mien
soul-crushing mien.text: Your resolution proves dangerous, and able to damage minds that even slightly contact your own.

indomitable idealism.name: Indomitable Idealism
indomitable idealism.text: An idea cannot be killed as long as it still inhabits a mind.

self beyond the self.name: Self Beyond the Self
self beyond the self.text: With your studied understanding of the mind and its motivations, beliefs, and ideals, you can temporarily subvert the spirit of a foe, briefly making them into a staunch ally.

unimpeachable authority of the sleeping.name: Unimpeachable Authority of the Sleeping Goddess
unimpeachable authority of the sleeping.text: You focus your spirit and belief, becoming a terrible and awe-inspiring sight; the world around you pales in comparison to your reality, and those who meet your eyes can feel your presence boring into their very soul.

immortal truths of the sleeping goddess.name: Immortal Truths of the Sleeping Goddess
immortal truths of the sleeping goddess.text: Standing at the pinnacle of the Sleeping Goddess disciplines students, you have the ability to share your beliefs in a way that no others can.

curving ray shot.name: Curving Ray Shot
curving ray shot.text: The disciples keen eyes allow him to fire his weapon around his foes cover.

horizon wind lancet.name: Horizon Wind Lancet
horizon wind lancet.text: The tenets of the Solar Wind have taught the disciple how to place more force behind his attacks.

phantom sun stance.name: Phantom Sun Stance
phantom sun stance.text: Using the principles of shadow and light, the Solar Wind disciple is capable of making phantom copies of his ammunition for use in combat.

solar sting.name: Solar Sting
solar sting.text: The Solar Wind disciple readies his attack and launches it into the sky.

stance of piercing rays.name: Stance of Piercing Rays
stance of piercing rays.text: A Solar Wind disciple learns to cause his ammunition to pierce like the burning rays of the sun itself.

steady hand.name: Steady Hand
steady hand.text: The disciples limbs and muscles are strong and wise with the knowledge of weapons in flight.

feel the wind.name: Feel The Wind
feel the wind.text: By studying the wind and air around him, the Solar Wind disciple learns to overcome his surroundings difficulties when using ranged weapons and may fire true.

intercepting shade.name: Intercepting Shade
intercepting shade.text: Sometimes a good offense can be used as a good defense, so the Solar Wind discipline learns, as he uses his range to dissuade attacks by his sheer skill and exceptional aim.

solar flare.name: Solar Flare
solar flare.text: Where the light of the sun touches, so does the burning reach of the Solar Wind disciple, allowing him to curve his weapons around impossible angles.

solar lance.name: Solar Lance
solar lance.text: The disciple focuses his energies into his weapon and lets loose a powerful shot in a gusting wind.

blinding ray shot.name: Blinding Ray Shot
blinding ray shot.text: The disciple wraps incandescent light with the brightness of the midday sun around his weapon and lets fly at an opponent.

phantom wind ray.name: Phantom Wind Ray
phantom wind ray.text: The disciples knowledge of the desert mirages caused by the sun grants him the ability to obscure his attacks, using gaps in a foes perception.

solar reflection.name: Solar Reflection
solar reflection.text: As reflective surfaces bounce the rays of the sun, so can the Solar Wind disciple ricochet a missile weapon from one target to another.

sunwalker stance.name: Sunwalker Stance
sunwalker stance.text: Using the hunting techniques of the ancient days of the White Steppes, the Solar Wind disciple hunts on the move, making attacks while chasing down his prey.

dazzling solar flare.name: Dazzling Solar Flare
dazzling solar flare.text: With swift and deadly precision, the disciple attacks with the force of the scorching sun.

disarming gust.name: Disarming Gust
disarming gust.text: A swift breeze and an explosion of agony is what the enemy of the disciple knows when this strike is used in battle as his sword hand is struck by the disciples skillful attack.

searing break.name: Searing Break
searing break.text: By binding the light of the suns rays into his weapons, the disciple of the Solar Wind may attack with the suns burning heat.

solar storm.name: Solar Storm
solar storm.text: By wrapping the winds of tornadic force around his weapon and attacking a foe or the ground at a targets feet, the Solar Wind disciple may cause a brief tornado to wrap around a target and both shield and limit their abilities.

blinding the bull.name: Blinding The Bull
blinding the bull.text: When a Solar Wind disciple finds the perfect shot, he makes sure that the attack is as destructive as a tornado on the plains.

double solar reflection.name: Double Solar Reflection
double solar reflection.text: The disciple of the Solar Wind may bend and reflect his missile weapons as an illusionist may bend and reflect light with mirrors.

focused solar lance.name: Focused Solar Lance
focused solar lance.text: The disciple raises his deadly weapon and lets loose an attack so powerful as to pin a target to the ground with a hurricane force wind.

solar wind lancet.name: Solar Wind Lancet
solar wind lancet.text: With the mighty force of the Solar Wind, the disciple lets loose a missile with breath-stealing, devastating force.

burning break.name: Burning Break
burning break.text: The burning wrath of the sun itself takes root in the disciples ammunition as he lets loose the wrath of the Solar Wind.

solar meteor blow.name: Solar Meteor Blow
solar meteor blow.text: The disciple of the Solar Wind wraps the force of a hurricane around his weapon before launching it high into the air to have it crash down amongst his enemies, scattering them to the ground.

true shot stance.name: True Shot Stance
true shot stance.text: The Solar Wind disciple has honed his incredible senses and while in this stance uses his inner vision to strike his foes with his most deadly attacks.

twisting wind shot.name: Twisting Wind Shot
twisting wind shot.text: The keen vision of the Solar Wind disciple allows him to pick out the vulnerable spots on a foes form and plant a missile directly into them.

phantom sunstorm.name: Phantom Sunstorm
phantom sunstorm.text: The disciple draws back one weapon and lets loose with a hundred.

stunning solar flare.name: Stunning Solar Flare
stunning solar flare.text: The Solar Wind disciple can steal the fight from an enemy with a single attack, such is his great skill.

triple solar reflection.name: Triple Solar Reflection
triple solar reflection.text: The Solar Wind disciple has mastered the art of the ricochet shot and may target up to four attackers.

aurora break.name: Aurora Break
aurora break.text: The Solar Wind disciple masters the light of the sky and burns with a nimbus of colors from sunset to the far northern lights.

solar hailstorm stance.name: Solar Hailstorm Stance
solar hailstorm stance.text: A master of the Solar Wind, the disciple may attack with the speed of the suns rays.

solar wind tsunami.name: Solar Wind Tsunami
solar wind tsunami.text: The disciple holds aloft a glowing weapon which burns with the wrath of the Solar Wind, and lets it loose against his foes in a wave of destruction.

solar wind nova.name: Solar Wind Nova
solar wind nova.text: The true champion and master of the Solar Wind may unleash this devastating attack against all of his foes by unleashing his attack towards the sky where it splits apart into a deadly rain of phantom weapons and brilliant sunlight.

backfist.name: Backfist
backfist.text: Sacrificing accuracy for speed and ferocity, the initiator follows up their weapon attack with a fierce backhand.

bladestrike.name: Bladestrike
bladestrike.text: When an enemys melee attack with a manufactured weapon would successfully strike the initiator, the initiator can make a free sunder attempt that does not provoke attacks of opportunity against the enemys weapon, using any weapon they are c

electric slide.name: Electric Slide
electric slide.text: While moving, the initiator may attempt to move directly through an opponents square, making an Acrobatics check against the opponents CMD bonuses the opponent gains to its CMD against being tripped apply against this maneuver.

eye of the storm sob.name: Eye of the Storm SoB
eye of the storm sob.text: The initiator enters a near meditative state, becoming hyper-sensitive to the movements of battle while simultaneously unlocking his own hidden potential.

flashcut.name: Flashcut
flashcut.text: Flourishing their weapon with expert skill, the initiators successful melee attack dazzles the opponent for 2 rounds and the initiator treats the target as flat-footed against the initiators first attack each round for the duration of the d

sparking blow.name: Sparking Blow
sparking blow.text: The initiators attack moves so fast the air sparks along his weapon, causing his successful attack to deal an additional 1d4 electricity damage.

air step.name: Air Step
air step.text: The initiator steps downward with extreme force while moving, allowing them to take up to half of their movement walking on air as though walking on solid ground.

crushing thunder.name: Crushing Thunder
crushing thunder.text: On a successful attack, the initiator strikes their opponent with concussive force, dealing normal damage and dazing them for 1 round unless they succeed on a Fortitude save DC 12 + primary initiator modifier.

doublestrike.name: Doublestrike
doublestrike.text: The initiators rapid speed allows him to catch an opponent a second time with the backswing of their weapon.

electric roll.name: Electric Roll
electric roll.text: When activating this boost, the initiator may make a DC 15 Acrobatics check to move up to twice their normal speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

thunder parry.name: Thunder Parry
thunder parry.text: When an enemys melee attack would successfully strike the initiator, they may make a free bull rush attempt against the enemy.

forked lightning.name: Forked Lightning
forked lightning.text: Using the fast-twitch muscles in their arms, the initiator is able to strike and then make a second attack in the same instant without withdrawing their arm.

grounding rod.name: Grounding Rod
grounding rod.text: When the initiator would be the target of a spell, power, or ability that deals electricity damage and grants a saving throw, they may make an Acrobatics check in place of the saving throw.

thunder walk.name: Thunder Walk
thunder walk.text: The initiators steps are made with such force that both earth and sky tremble at his approach.

volt dance.name: Volt Dance
volt dance.text: Ride the lightning. Be the lightning. When the initiator would be dealt electricity damage by a ranged attack, effect, or spell that originated within 60 feet, they may choose to instantaneously travel to the source of the attack.

electric thrust.name: Electric Thrust
electric thrust.text: Lunging forward in a vicious thrust, the initiator extends their body to strike from an unexpected distance with surprising force.

incandescent strike.name: Incandescent Strike
incandescent strike.text: Charging their attack with the raw power of a lightning bolt, the initiator can strike their opponent while unleashing a blinding bolt of electricity.

spin kick.name: Spin Kick
spin kick.text: Chaining fluid movements together, the initiator follows up his successful weapon attack with a thunderous roundhouse kick.

sundered falcon swing.name: Sundered Falcon Swing
sundered falcon swing.text: Leaping into the air, the initiator unleashes a potent attack that rends the air with such force it launches a concussive blast of energy outwards.

charged wheel.name: Charged Wheel
charged wheel.text: The initiator makes one melee attack at their highest base attack bonus against each opponent within reach.

lightning parry stance.name: Lightning Parry Stance
lightning parry stance.text: The initiators skill allows them to instinctively sense and react to incoming attacks.

ozone shimmer.name: Ozone Shimmer
ozone shimmer.text: The initiators lightning fast movements are scarcely visible as a blur on the battlefield.

skyscream.name: Skyscream
skyscream.text: The initiator jumps into the air, twisting their body to bring their weapon crashing down with such speed that the air itself is rent apart, causing the initiators successful attack to deal an additional 6d6 points of electricity damage.

aerial dash.name: Aerial Dash
aerial dash.text: The initiators steps are made with such force that they can propel themselves through the air.

form of thunder.name: Form of Thunder
form of thunder.text: The initiator learns to unlock their bodys natural limiters, unleashing a roiling surge of energy that suffuses their entire being.

lightning strikes.name: Lightning Strikes
lightning strikes.text: The initiators attack moves with such speed and force that armor cannot impede them.

soaring falcon flurry.name: Soaring Falcon Flurry
soaring falcon flurry.text: Leaping into the air, the initiator unleashes a flurry of attacks that rend the air with such force they launch a concussive blast of energy outwards.

stance of storms.name: Stance of Storms
stance of storms.text: The initiators stamina is nearly unmatched, allowing him to air step as easily as walking.

thunders fury.name: Thunders Fury
thunders fury.text: The initiator chains up to three powerful thrusts together in lightning succession.

electric pinwheel.name: Electric Pinwheel
electric pinwheel.text: Hurtling at their enemy in a destructive cartwheel, the initiator may make a single melee attack with a manufactured weapon.

oakrender.name: Oakrender
oakrender.text: Leaping into the air, the initiator crashes to earth with such force that their attack can split an opponent in twain.

skyscream dance.name: Skyscream Dance
skyscream dance.text: The initiator performs a leaping spiral into the air, surrounding their weapon with crackling lightning before crashing down, causing the initiators successful attack to deal an additional 4d6 points of electricity damage and 4d6 points of

stigmata of storm.name: Stigmata of Storm
stigmata of storm.text: Masters of the Spark of Battle may unleash this devastating attack in a destructive and lightning fast flurry that decimates their opponent.

body of the night.name: Body of the Night
body of the night.text: A wielder of the secrets of Steel Serpent knows his body and how to use it effectively in the art of stealth.

dizzying venom prana.name: Dizzying Venom Prana
dizzying venom prana.text: By focusing hiskionto a weapon, the disciple readies a spiritual poison which dizzies and confuses the minds of his foes.

hunting serpent blow.name: Hunting Serpent Blow
hunting serpent blow.text: The disciple hunts his foe through the emulation of a hunting serpent, obfuscating his true attack until the moment he strikes.

poisoners stance.name: Poisoners Stance
poisoners stance.text: One of the first lessons of Steel Serpent disciples is the knowledge of mundane poisons and how to use them with expertise.

sting of the rattler.name: Sting of the Rattler
sting of the rattler.text: Disciples of Steel Serpent learn to emulate the swift and powerful strikes of the serpent kingdom and leave lasting wounds through the power of theirki.By focusing this harmful energy into a single attack, the disciple may cause more grievo

fading dodge.name: Fading Dodge
fading dodge.text: By using his knowledge of anatomy to contort away from a strike, the Steel Serpent disciple may bend away from an attackers grasp and make a swift counter-offensive.

iron fang.name: Iron Fang
iron fang.text: By hardeningkialong edge of his weapon, the Steel Serpent disciple uses the pressure of hiskito penetrate the defenses of his foe.

sting of the asp.name: Sting of the Asp
sting of the asp.text: Through the use of this maneuver, the disciple readies a weakening dose ofkienergy with his weapons strike to sap his foe of its power.

weakening venom prana.name: Weakening Venom Prana
weakening venom prana.text: By forming a deadly weakening sheen ofkipoison along his weapon, the disciple strikes at his foes physical might.

nights knife.name: Nights Knife
nights knife.text: With the surgical precision of the striking serpent, the disciple lands an attack with exacting damage through his knowledge of anatomy.

sickening venom strike.name: Sickening Venom Strike
sickening venom strike.text: With a sharp jab of sickeningkienergy, the Steel Serpent disciple can rob an enemy of his will to continue to fight as their body rebels against them.

sight piercing fang.name: Sight Piercing Fang
sight piercing fang.text: With the swiftness of a striking snake, the disciple makes a jab at his opponents face to temporarily steal its vision.

steel coils.name: Steel Coils
