steel coils.text: In this stance, the movements and motions of the disciple become more sinuous and deliberate, as if he were a serpent coiled to strike.

poison blood.name: Poison Blood
poison blood.text: Every disciple of Steel Serpent has long accepted that in battle, sometimes the superior warrior gets injured.

rattlers feint.name: Rattlers Feint
rattlers feint.text: Just as the rattlesnakes tail serves as a distraction to its prey, the disciple of Steel Serpent learns to obscure his attack by causing his opponent to look where he wants him to.

sting of the adder.name: Sting of the Adder
sting of the adder.text: Striking with surety and precision, the disciple attacks the chakra of wisdom on his foe with hiskiin an attempt to cloud his foes mind.

tearing fang.name: Tearing Fang
tearing fang.text: Weakening a foe with repeated nips and bleeding wounds will cripple them, so the Steel Serpent mantra goes, and then you may proceed with the kill.

burning venom prana.name: Burning Venom Prana
burning venom prana.text: By focusing hiskialong the edge of a close combat weapon, the disciple readies his energies to disrupt his foes mind with burning mental fire.

hooded killers stance.name: Hooded Killers Stance
hooded killers stance.text: The disciple adopts the mannerisms and cold blooded nature of the hooded cobra, the lord of serpent kind.

pressure point break.name: Pressure Point Break
pressure point break.text: Just as the deadly coils of the constrictor snake may squeeze the life out of a foe, the Steel Serpent disciple has learned to use his knowledge of his foes body against him in surprising ways.

steel fang.name: Steel Fang
steel fang.text: The spiritualkifocus of the disciple is so intense that it gains armor piercing force when applied to a weapon or hand strike.

blend with the night.name: Blend With The Night
blend with the night.text: Practitioners of the Steel Serpent discipline are known for their ability to disappear while in plain sight and reappear moments later, unleashing their devastating skill upon a subject.

spitting cobra stance.name: Spitting Cobra Stance
spitting cobra stance.text: Some serpents spit their venom, and as they are deadly at a distance so does the disciple learn to be deadlier at range with his attacks.

sting of the viper.name: Sting of the Viper
sting of the viper.text: The disciple reaches out and strikes at his opponents will and force of being, crushing his foes chakras with hiski.

virulence.name: Virulence
virulence.text: Through intense focus, the disciple is capable of increasing the potency of venoms and poisons he uses by channeling hiskiinto them and twisting that energy.

bite the mongoose.name: Bite The Mongoose
bite the mongoose.text: Inevitably, the disciple of Steel Serpent will be struck in combat and through the use of this technique; he learns to make his foe regret its actions.

desert serpent mirage.name: Desert Serpent Mirage
desert serpent mirage.text: One of the Steel Serpents teachings is that for a disciple to be successful, he must find his opponents blind spot.

numbing venom prana.name: Numbing Venom Prana
numbing venom prana.text: By filling his next attack with chill and numbingkienergies, the Steel Serpent disciple strikes at the nervous energies that cause the body to move, draining away from the victim his grace and motor control.

silencing strike.name: Silencing Strike
silencing strike.text: By focusing hiskiand striking at a foes throat chakra, he can close it temporarily and cut off the targets ability to speak.

adamantine fang.name: Adamantine Fang
adamantine fang.text: When initiating this maneuver, the disciple congeals the totality of hiskialong his weapon which glitters almost like a diamond just before he strikes.

hooded cobra attitude.name: Hooded Cobra Attitude
hooded cobra attitude.text: By adopting this stance, the disciple of Steel Serpent evokes the menacing dread of the hooded cobra.

sting of the cobra.name: Sting of the Cobra
sting of the cobra.text: By focusing destructive, life-destroyingkiinto his attack, the Steel Serpent disciple strikes at the very heart of his foes life force.

five-fold hydra sting.name: Five-Fold Hydra Sting
five-fold hydra sting.text: A true master of the discipline of Steel Serpent possesses the knowledge how to use his skill,ki, and knowledge of the systems of living creatures, putting them to use for ending of a life.

shrimp snap.name: Shrimp Snap
shrimp snap.text: Like a crab, you snap forward and hold on tight.

sand shark rush.name: Sand Shark Rush
sand shark rush.text: Your prey cannot escape your charging maw.

stance of the pistol shrimp.name: Stance of the Pistol Shrimp
stance of the pistol shrimp.text: A bubble of air surrounds your weapons, allowing them to pass through water without resistance.

stance of the sea turtle.name: Stance of the Sea Turtle
stance of the sea turtle.text: You have learned breathing exercises and special movements to emulate amphibious creatures.

shark surge.name: Shark Surge
shark surge.text: Your speed is your defense. After initiating this boost, your next charge attack including maneuvers which allow a charge made this round does not inflict the normal -2 penalty to your AC.

whirlpool spin.name: Whirlpool Spin
whirlpool spin.text: With a swirl, you block your foes blade. Make a Swim check against a foes attack roll.

breathless strike.name: Breathless Strike
breathless strike.text: You steal precious air from your foes lungs.

crab snap.name: Crab Snap
crab snap.text: Hold fast and dont let go! Make an attack.

hammerhead rush.name: Hammerhead Rush
hammerhead rush.text: Your blow strikes your foe like a hammer and leaves them reeling.

eel energize.name: Eel Energize
eel energize.text: You fill your weapons with an electrical charge.

tail snap.name: Tail Snap
tail snap.text: With a swift movement, you knock your foe away.

moray lunge.name: Moray Lunge
moray lunge.text: You lash out with such speed that your prey never sees you coming.

pufferfish spines.name: Pufferfish Spines
pufferfish spines.text: Those who would strike you find too late theyve made a fatal mistake.

stance of the surging shark.name: Stance of the Surging Shark
stance of the surging shark.text: Your powerful movements propel you along, right through your foes.

walrus rampage.name: Walrus Rampage
walrus rampage.text: Like the tusks of a mighty walrus, your blows are twice as powerful.

cephalapod surprise.name: Cephalapod Surprise
cephalapod surprise.text: Clever and cunning, you trick your foes into futile attacks.

coral shatter.name: Coral Shatter
coral shatter.text: With a mighty blow, you break your foes defense like fragile coral.

great white rush.name: Great White Rush
great white rush.text: With a terrifying burst of speed, you tear through lesser creatures, seeking your prey.

breath bandit.name: Breath Bandit
breath bandit.text: You draw air from those around you, stealing the vital force for yourself.

riptide slash.name: Riptide Slash
riptide slash.text: With a single stroke, you create a deadly current that shreds flesh and shears bone.

sharkskin shred.name: Sharkskin Shred
sharkskin shred.text: Your skin grows rough and thick, impervious to the feeble attacks of your prey.

stance of the hermit crab.name: Stance of the Hermit Crab
stance of the hermit crab.text: You know the secret of the humble hermit crab, carrying its home on its back.

vicegrip snap.name: Vicegrip Snap
vicegrip snap.text: Your grip is swift and unyielding. Make an attack.

ink cloud.name: Ink Cloud
ink cloud.text: Like a tricky squid, you exhale a foul cloud of ink.

shark frenzy rush.name: Shark Frenzy Rush
shark frenzy rush.text: You smell blood in the water, and your hunger is clear and terrifying.

torrent in the water.name: Torrent in the Water
torrent in the water.text: Adopting a more violent moveset, you are protected by the thrashing of water around you.

crab cruncher.name: Crab Cruncher
crab cruncher.text: You crush your foe with mighty blows, rending flesh and holding them fast.

mantis shrimp retaliation.name: Mantis Shrimp Retaliation
mantis shrimp retaliation.text: With a swift strike, you anticipate your foes attack before they even complete it.

disrupting jaws.name: Disrupting Jaws
disrupting jaws.text: You may initiate this boost after having made a successful attack that dealt damage against a locked target.

splintered coral reef.name: Splintered Coral Reef
splintered coral reef.text: Full of rage, you summon forth pieces of broken coral reefs and fire them with vengeance at your hated foes.

fin in the water.name: Fin in the Water
fin in the water.text: You know how to move with the terrifying grace of a shark, raising its fin out of the water to inflict fear upon those who see their inevitable doom coming towards them.

leviathan annihilation.name: Leviathan Annihilation
leviathan annihilation.text: With a mighty swing, you hit your target with overwhelming force that even shreds mighty sea vessels like they were paper.

stance of the frenzied shark.name: Stance of the Frenzied Shark
stance of the frenzied shark.text: You become a dweller of the deep, swift, powerful, unstoppable.

wrath of the kraken.name: Wrath of the Kraken
wrath of the kraken.text: Your blows flail out like the tentacles of the mighty kraken, striking all with devastating force.

disarming shot.name: Disarming Shot
disarming shot.text: Your careful training allows you to fire shots from an unexpected angle and strike opponents where they least expect it, their weapons.

distant gale.name: Distant Gale
distant gale.text: Firing with the strength of the winds at your back, you unleash an attack that becomes more dangerous the more distance it travels.

eye of the needle.name: Eye of the Needle
eye of the needle.text: For most archers, an enemy engaged in melee is a difficult target at best, but for you a smaller target only presents greater opportunity.

galebreakers stance.name: Galebreakers Stance
galebreakers stance.text: Your ability to accurately read the wind allows you to fight effectively even in the most adverse conditions.

slipstream strike.name: Slipstream Strike
slipstream strike.text: The most basic protection against an arrow is some form of cover, but you know many ways to negate this defense.

snipers eye stance.name: Snipers Eye Stance
snipers eye stance.text: As a Tempest Gale disciple, distance is no obstacle to you.

deflecting shot.name: Deflecting Shot
deflecting shot.text: You know well that a sudden shot can disrupt the enemy and remove a potential threat.

distracting draft.name: Distracting Draft
distracting draft.text: Your well placed shot can both hurt the enemy and put them of their guard.

dustcatching breeze.name: Dustcatching Breeze
dustcatching breeze.text: You target your enemy with unscrupulous tactics, throwing them of balance and allowing your allies to seize the advantage.

piercing shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing shot.text: The power behind your ranged attacks is such that they can strike through one foe to pierce another behind them.

sudden gust.name: Sudden Gust
sudden gust.text: Your placed shot can knock an enemy to the ground as easily as a mighty sword swing.

battering gale.name: Battering Gale
battering gale.text: Your arrows strike with such force that they can drive back even the mightiest foes.

cascading draft.name: Cascading Draft
cascading draft.text: Reading the winds allows you to hit further and strike harder than any other martial artist.

disarming blast.name: Disarming Blast
disarming blast.text: With a combination of might and skill, you fire a shot that hits with such force it disarms the enemy.

tempest gale stance.name: Tempest Gale Stance
tempest gale stance.text: You move as swiftly as the wind, and strike with all the fury of the storm.

cutting gale.name: Cutting Gale
cutting gale.text: Your arrows leave wounds which bleed more fiercely than the pinpricks of a thousand lesser archers.

exploding gale.name: Exploding Gale
exploding gale.text: Even those who hide behind their fellows cannot save themselves from your deadly shots.

iron wind.name: Iron Wind
iron wind.text: A single powerful blow can leave an enemy reeling, and you excel at delivering such blows.

wind tunnel.name: Wind Tunnel
wind tunnel.text: No foe can hide from your sharp eyes. After you initiate this boost, your ranged attacks for one round ignore any cover bonuses to the targets AC, and you do not take penalties on attack rolls from attacking creatures beyond your weapons fi

blinding shot maneuver.name: Blinding Shot maneuver
blinding shot maneuver.text: With a skilled shot, you take your opponents sight, and with it, the threat they pose.

dancing winds stance.name: Dancing Winds Stance
dancing winds stance.text: The wind whips around you as you move, guarding you against attacks so long as you remain in motion.

false wind.name: False Wind
false wind.text: You unleash a rapid shot that distracts or disables an enemy, preventing them from harming you or your ally.

grounding shot.name: Grounding Shot
grounding shot.text: Your slings and arrows can bring down even the mightiest fliers, dropping them to the earth where their wings mean nothing.

piercing gale.name: Piercing Gale
piercing gale.text: No foe can withstand the force of your weapons.

razor tempest.name: Razor Tempest
razor tempest.text: A scything wind seems to follow your attacks, leaving gashes that bleed profusely in the flesh of your enemy.

trick of the wind.name: Trick of the Wind
trick of the wind.text: Your skill at reading the wind is such that the very air itself seems to bend to your will.

wind lance.name: Wind Lance
wind lance.text: Your attacks strike with the force of a mounted cavalry charge.

winds of vengeance stance.name: Winds of Vengeance Stance
winds of vengeance stance.text: Every move that your enemies make is an opportunity for you, and one that you relish taking advantage of.

black wind.name: Black Wind
black wind.text: You unleash a mighty shot that thunders through enemy lines, knocking aside any in its path.

hunting zephyr.name: Hunting Zephyr
hunting zephyr.text: As a master of the Tempest Gale, you never miss your mark; each shot is perfect.

punishing tempest.name: Punishing Tempest
punishing tempest.text: Each shot you fire contains the force necessary to drive back even the sturdiest opponent, or knock them of their feet.

eye of the storm.name: Eye of the Storm
eye of the storm.text: Like the calm winds at the center of a hurricane, you are bastion of serenity on the chaos of the battlefield.

steel tornado.name: Steel Tornado
steel tornado.text: Your masterful shot spins your enemy around with incredible force, causing them to lose their grip and their balance.

vicious tempest volley.name: Vicious Tempest Volley
vicious tempest volley.text: Unleashing the might of the winds to carry your attacks throughout the battlefield, you launch a hail of arrows, bolts, stones or weapons to devastate your enemies.

inner sphere stance.name: Inner Sphere Stance
inner sphere stance.text: A defensive stance that focuses on using the disciples dance-like movements to confound his foe, Stance allows the disciple to use erratic movements to defend himself and bolster his confidence.

leaping dragon.name: Leaping Dragon
leaping dragon.text: As a dragon takes wing, his powerful legs thrust him skyward as his wings spread out to clutch the air.

offensive roll.name: Offensive Roll
offensive roll.text: As the disciple moves by his opponent, he may drop into a tumbling roll and strike at it from a surprising angle.

outer sphere stance.name: Outer Sphere Stance
outer sphere stance.text: The Thrashing Dragon disciple flips both of his blades down and concentrates solely on slaying his foe without heed to his own life.

swift claws.name: Swift Claws
swift claws.text: The Thrashing Dragon disciples skill with his dual weapons allows him to strike with practiced speed and alacrity, allowing him to make an attack with two wielded weapons or unarmed strikes, using the same attack action.

wyrmlings fang.name: Wyrmlings Fang
wyrmlings fang.text: With a quick flick of his wrist, the disciple hurls a blade deeply into his foe with blinding speed.

flash kick.name: Flash Kick
flash kick.text: As part of a full attack action, the disciple may make a powerful and swift kick while his blades strike.

flick of the wrist.name: Flick of the Wrist
flick of the wrist.text: With two rapid slaps from his blades, the Thrashing Dragon disciples ferocity puts an opponent off balance and with a flick of the wrist the disciple takes away the weapon of his foe.

reflexive twist.name: Reflexive Twist
reflexive twist.text: With his athletic abilities and reflexes honed to a razors edge, the Thrashing Dragon disciple may incorporate reflexive evasions into his fighting dance at a moments notice to defend himself from danger.

sun dips low.name: Sun Dips Low
sun dips low.text: With a sudden, darting movement the Thrashing Dragon disciple may dodge an attack and protect himself from harm, if perfectly timed.

sweeping tail.name: Sweeping Tail
sweeping tail.text: Within his battle dance, the disciple dips low and sweeps his leg out to knock an opponent down.

ancients fang.name: Ancients Fang
ancients fang.text: With a powerful overhand throw, the Thrashing Dragon disciple hurls one of his blades into his foes form with force and power rivaling the snapping jaws of an ancient dragon.

battle dragons stance.name: Battle Dragons Stance
battle dragons stance.text: The Battle Dragons Stance shows the disciple how to balance his fighting style and through this centering of being, he may find speed, finesse, and power.

fangs strike low.name: Fangs Strike Low
fangs strike low.text: By forcing an opponents guard up, the Thrashing Dragon spins low and attacks at the legs of the target to reduce his mobility and cause deep, flensing wounds.

vicious swipe.name: Vicious Swipe
vicious swipe.text: The disciples combat style allows him to get in close to a target and strike beneath its guard, dealing a powerful blow and potentially knocking it senseless for a few moments.

devastation roll.name: Devastation Roll
devastation roll.text: The martial disciples movements are so quick and precise, his deadly strikes are hard to evade.

dragon assault.name: Dragon Assault
dragon assault.text: By unleashing his full wrath against his enemies, a Thrashing Dragon disciple is capable of inflicting incredibly powerful blows that get more potent per successive hit.

dragon rush.name: Dragon Rush
dragon rush.text: With the ferocity of a dragon, the disciple follows through a successful attack with a vicious kick to his foe to keep punishing the fool who would stand before the might of a Thrashing Dragon.

sharpened talons.name: Sharpened Talons
sharpened talons.text: As a dragon might drag his claws across a castle wall to hone their edge, the disciple has learned to give his own attacks a deadly edge for his next attack.

bend with the wind.name: Bend with the Wind
bend with the wind.text: The graceful, flowing movements of the Thrashing Dragons dance helps defend the disciple in combat while providing him the ability to move through danger unscathed.

hurricane of fangs.name: Hurricane of Fangs
hurricane of fangs.text: Utilizing this technique, a Thrashing Dragon disciple is capable of hurling multiple blades at a target in rapid succession with brutal power and incredible accuracy and range.

reversing thrust.name: Reversing Thrust
reversing thrust.text: By watching the form of the enemy attacking him, the disciple may expertly twist and dodge way from the attack while making an attack on his foe in return.

thrashing dragon twist.name: Thrashing Dragon Twist
thrashing dragon twist.text: Like a coiled spring, the disciple of the Thrashing Dragon twists his body and with powerful recoil, he spins to swipe at all of his available targets.

great wyrms fang.name: Great Wyrms Fang
great wyrms fang.text: By focusing his will into one of his blades, the Thrashing Dragon disciple wields the power of a mighty great wyrm in the palm of his hand.

rending claws.name: Rending Claws
rending claws.text: When both of his blades strike home, the Thrashing Dragon disciple may rend and tear with his blades to cause excruciatingly painful and deadly injuries.

tail slap.name: Tail Slap
tail slap.text: As the true dragon fights and employs all of its mighty limbs in combat, so does the disciple that emulates their graceful and deadly style.

unbreakable talons.name: Unbreakable Talons
unbreakable talons.text: Using his superior skill and speed, the disciple knows where and how to strike for maximum effectiveness.

alacrity on wing.name: Alacrity on Wing
alacrity on wing.text: With reflexes honed from many combats, the disciple may react to danger with speed so great he may even attack multiple times while he evades the unlucky attacker.

brutal dragons stance.name: Brutal Dragons Stance
brutal dragons stance.text: A Thrashing Dragon disciple sometimes realizes that the best defense is having a field of lifeless opponents at his feet.

thrashing dragon frenzy.name: Thrashing Dragon Frenzy
thrashing dragon frenzy.text: By focusing on the principles of speed and power, the Thrashing Dragon disciple explodes into motion, making a vicious flurry of strikes against all nearby attackers in a deadly dance of death.

doom talon.name: Doom Talon
doom talon.text: When a potentially deadly strike occurs, the Thrashing Dragon disciple knows how to make the blow count.

dragon warriors talons.name: Dragon Warriors Talons
dragon warriors talons.text: With mastery of the Thrashing Dragons dance comes supremacy in effectiveness and efficiency with the arms that emulate the weapons of the dragon race.

thrashing blades.name: Thrashing Blades
thrashing blades.text: With the speed and ferocity of a rampaging dragon, the disciple rends his foe to ribbons with his furious onslaught as he turns the quickening principles of fighting many opponents to fight only one.

deadly dragon strike.name: Deadly Dragon Strike
deadly dragon strike.text: Upon reaching mastery of the Thrashing Dragon discipline, the disciple learns the truth of his deadly war dance; at its center is a deadly calm.

bean nighe attitude.name: Bean nighe Attitude
bean nighe attitude.text: By reading whispers of impending death, you stay one step ahead of your fate, avoiding even magical attempts on your life.

gravekeepers hood.name: Gravekeepers Hood
gravekeepers hood.text: Drawing on the power that gives sight to the sightless dead, your vision transcends mortal limits.

hungry stillness strike.name: Hungry Stillness Strike
hungry stillness strike.text: You infuse your weapon with negative energy as you strike your foe.

starving vampire stance.name: Starving Vampire Stance
starving vampire stance.text: When you assume this stance, you skin gains a deathly pallor, and your canines, if any, sharpen and elongate.

thirsty axe strike.name: Thirsty Axe Strike
thirsty axe strike.text: Drawing on the primal hunger of the negative energy plane, you lash out at your victim.

whisper of undeath.name: Whisper of Undeath
whisper of undeath.text: You infuse yourself with subtle threads of negative energy.

chilling grave defense.name: Chilling Grave Defense
chilling grave defense.text: You afflict an attacker with the chill of the grave, sapping the strength from their limbs.

headstone breaking strike.name: Headstone Breaking Strike
headstone breaking strike.text: You mimic the savage fury of the undying, breaking the bodies of your foes.

raging specter strike.name: Raging Specter Strike
raging specter strike.text: You transmute your weapon into a semi-ethereal state, striking with the undying hate of a specter.

rattling skeleton parry.name: Rattling Skeleton Parry
rattling skeleton parry.text: Your flesh shrivels, revealing hard bones that turn aside enemy weapons.

stalking ghoul.name: Stalking Ghoul
stalking ghoul.text: You move with the swiftness and cunning of the cannibalistic ghouls.

avenging revenant's advance.name: Avenging Revenant's Advance
avenging revenant's advance.text: When you assume this stance, your skin pales and your breath fogs with the chill of the grave.

darkened axe style.name: Darkened Axe Style
darkened axe style.text: You infuse your attacks with negative energy, draining the life of your victims.

life stealing strike.name: Life Stealing Strike
life stealing strike.text: You afflict your victim with an entropic curse, sealing their life force away from succor.

wight's blow.name: Wight's Blow
wight's blow.text: You call upon the anger of the hungry wight, draining the vital essence of your foes.

hunting mohrg strike.name: Hunting Mohrg Strike
hunting mohrg strike.text: Your axe lashes out like a hungry mohrg. Make a melee attack.

rotting axe style.name: Rotting Axe Style
rotting axe style.text: You draw upon the destructive entropy of the negative energy plane, infusing it into your strikes.

shrieking shadow axe.name: Shrieking Shadow Axe
shrieking shadow axe.text: You wrap your weapon in tenebrous energy that saps the strength of your victims.

wretched ghast riposte.name: Wretched Ghast Riposte
wretched ghast riposte.text: You afflict an attacker with the charnel stench of the ghast, ruining their blow.

ancient lich parry.name: Ancient Lich Parry
ancient lich parry.text: You shield yourself with webs of entropic energy that sap at magic directed at you.

flowing gore blow.name: Flowing Gore Blow
flowing gore blow.text: Your axe flows forth with negative energy, creating a cursed wound.

howling banshee strike.name: Howling Banshee Strike
howling banshee strike.text: Your weapon screams like a grieving banshee as you drive it into your foe.

mourning ghost attitude.name: Mourning Ghost Attitude
mourning ghost attitude.text: When you assume this stance, your outline smudges gently and your hair and equipment become semi-transparent, as though you had become a ghost.

ascending necromancer style.name: Ascending Necromancer Style
ascending necromancer style.text: You wrap yourself in armoring layers of negative energy, shielding your life force with the touch of undeath.

feasting wraith strike.name: Feasting Wraith Strike
feasting wraith strike.text: Sickly gray tar clings to your blade as you initiate this dread strike.

headman's descending axe.name: Headman's Descending Axe
headman's descending axe.text: You cleave into your foe with an executioners strike.

looming nightwalker parry.name: Looming Nightwalker Parry
looming nightwalker parry.text: You transform your body into shadowy energy, turning blows aside.

charging dullahan's advance.name: Charging Dullahan's Advance
charging dullahan's advance.text: Your head vanishes when you assume this stance, leaving behind a dripping, bloody neck stump this may complicate attempts to identify you.

poltergeist's wrath.name: Poltergeist's Wrath
poltergeist's wrath.text: You strike out with your weapon and emit a wave of rage and sorrow that brings your victim to their knees.

scything reaper riposte.name: Scything Reaper Riposte
scything reaper riposte.text: You form a scythe of crackling negative energy and sweep it through your attacker, draining their vital essence.

chilling mist sidestep.name: Chilling Mist Sidestep
chilling mist sidestep.text: You turn into dark mist that crackles with negative energy.

laughing demilich attitude.name: Laughing Demilich Attitude
laughing demilich attitude.text: The skin and muscle of your face pull tightly against your skull when you assume this stance, revealing yellow bone studded with phantasmal gemstones that crackle and dance with negative energy.

soul drinking strike.name: Soul Drinking Strike
soul drinking strike.text: You channel the all-consuming void through your axe, brutally rending your victims soul.

pitiless axe of the executioner.name: Pitiless Axe of the Executioner
pitiless axe of the executioner.text: Your weapon descends in a merciless swing, its cursed edge crawling into the wounds of your victims.

dimensional strike.name: Dimensional Strike
dimensional strike.text: By shifting slightly between two worlds, the disciple confuses the senses of his foe so he may land his attack more easily.

disturbing blow.name: Disturbing Blow
disturbing blow.text: By establishing counter-resonance within the spirit of an enemy with a well-placed blow, the disciple may disrupt and disturb its next action.

ghost hunting blow.name: Ghost Hunting Blow
ghost hunting blow.text: By reaching across the barrier between worlds, the disciple may strike at disembodied spirits as easily he would strike a normal mortal.

inner sense.name: Inner Sense
inner sense.text: By sensing ripples in the spiritual world around him, the Veiled Moon disciple is capable of better avoiding dangerous effects and situations.

leaping spirit dance.name: Leaping Spirit Dance
leaping spirit dance.text: Light as a feather, the Veiled Moon disciple moves gracefully in combat, with the smooth and practiced grace of an incorporeal being.

spirit sensing stance.name: Spirit Sensing Stance
spirit sensing stance.text: By sensing the different patterns all beings that exist have, the senses of the Veiled Moon disciple exceed that of natural beings and move into the realm of supernatural awareness.

cursed fate.name: Cursed Fate
cursed fate.text: The disciple can befuddle and bewilder his opponent with this strike, causing a grave imbalance in the psyche of the victim.

fading strike.name: Fading Strike
fading strike.text: The disciple learns the basic technique at this level for walking between worlds to reach locations that previously could be inaccessible on the mortal world and potentially attack foes at those locales.

half-gone.name: Half-Gone
half-gone.text: By momentarily slipping through the barrier between the Material and the Astral planes, the Veiled Moon disciple may attempt to avoid an attack by being incorporeal.

resonance strike.name: Resonance Strike
resonance strike.text: By funneling his spiritual power into his attack, the Veiled Moon practitioner may strike an opponent with glowing silvery light on the Material or the Ethereal plane.

altered penumbra.name: Altered Penumbra
altered penumbra.text: Position is relative to the Veiled Moon disciples thinking, and his position in the universe is mutable.

brilliant moon.name: Brilliant Moon
brilliant moon.text: By partially phasing a portion of his attack out of this reality, the disciple may ignore certain obstacles, such as armor, when striking at an opponent.

formless dance.name: Formless Dance
formless dance.text: The Veiled Moon disciple immerses himself in a sort of dimensional flux, causing him to be able to see what cannot be perceived and seemingly be in many places at once.

ghostwalk.name: Ghostwalk
ghostwalk.text: The initiator steps through to the borderland between the Material and the Ethereal planes, becoming an incorporeal figure in both realities for a few moments.

breath of the moon.name: Breath of the Moon
breath of the moon.text: The moon is a source of madness, so the legend goes, and by using the principles of lunar cycles on the psyche of mortals, the disciple may temporarily relieve a target of its sanity for a few moments in combat.

ethereal reminiscence.name: Ethereal Reminiscence
ethereal reminiscence.text: The ectoplasmic nature of beings on the Ethereal plane allows for the Veiled Moon disciple to briefly transport himself to that realm and use his will to restore some his form by filling his wounds with spectral energies, displacing his inj

fading leap.name: Fading Leap
fading leap.text: With nary a thought and a gesture the Veiled Moon disciple may flow like moonlight from one location to another through the Astral plane, moving faster than his earthly body would allow.

flicker strike.name: Flicker Strike
flicker strike.text: In a flickering blur of teleportation and movement, the Veiled Moon disciple may disappear, blink into existence to strike a foe, and then disappear again to appear a safe distance away.

essence shattering strike.name: Essence Shattering Strike
essence shattering strike.text: With a powerful strike, the Veiled Moon disciple attacks at the very spirit of his foe with his silver-blue light.

stance of the ether gate.name: Stance of the Ether Gate
stance of the ether gate.text: By shifting his essence partially into the Astral plane, the disciple finds that moving through that plane as just as easy as moving through the Material plane.

twisting ether.name: Twisting Ether
twisting ether.text: With a nod to his ally, the Veiled Moon adept may sink through the world with his ally and switch places with him for better effect in combat.

warp worm.name: Warp Worm
warp worm.text: By creating temporary breaches between the worlds of the Material and the Astral, the disciple may teleport through a few enemies and emerge from the space between worlds having done his foes great internal harm.

ether wave.name: Ether Wave
ether wave.text: The Veiled Moon disciple concentrates his spiritual energies to his hand and tears into the barrier between the Astral and the Material, and releases the energies that form from this in a wracking wave of silvery-blue energy.

phantom penumbra.name: Phantom Penumbra
phantom penumbra.text: To slip through the worlds is a simple matter for the disciple, and using this to deceive and evade an attacker is effortlessly done.

spiritual weapon stance.name: Spiritual Weapon Stance
spiritual weapon stance.text: By channeling ethereal energies along his weapons and his body, the initiator becomes immersed in both worlds, being as solid on the Ethereal Plane as he is on the Material.

vaporform crash.name: Vaporform Crash
vaporform crash.text: The Veiled Moon teaches that its disciples must know how to balance the scales between both worlds, so to make a foe real in the Material world, then the disciple must briefly sojourn to the other side.

dispersal strike.name: Dispersal Strike
dispersal strike.text: With a powerful strike and flash of silver-blue light, the disciple slams his foe directly into the Ethereal for a few moments, causing it to become ghostly and unreal.

fade through.name: Fade Through
fade through.text: An advanced technique, the Veiled Moon disciple at this point learns how to fold two points in space around him to appear at another location within the span of a heart beat.

flashing ether touch.name: Flashing Ether Touch
flashing ether touch.text: With but a touch the Veiled Moon disciple may send a foe hurtling through the Astral to reappear with frightening velocity to hit the ground.

anchoring spirit.name: Anchoring Spirit
anchoring spirit.text: The Veiled Moon disciple pulls himself fully into the Ethereal and manifests a ghostly apparition of his form upon the Material, and in doing so he locks his immediate area for travel through the Ethereal or Astral plane.

eclipsing moon.name: Eclipsing Moon
eclipsing moon.text: Folding space around his form effortlessly, the disciple is capable of leaps through the ether and attacking through the barrier between the worlds in a series of staccato bursts of silvery-blue light, his image blinking as he strikes.

lunar penumbra.name: Lunar Penumbra
lunar penumbra.text: It is said that the moon is portrayed in some legends as a laughing trickster, and with this powerful ability, the Veiled Moon disciple is capable of pulling an incredible trick upon his foe.

banish to the beyond.name: Banish to the Beyond
banish to the beyond.text: The ultimate technique of the Veiled Moon disciple is the ability to lay a mark against a target and shunt it gently into the Astral plane where it may ponder its reasons for crossing the likes of a master.
